title: AI Google Flow Video Editor Expert— Meta Ads Dropshipping
description:
Are YOU an experienced video editor who specializes in Meta Ads for ecommerce brands? Can you look at a competitor's winning ad and immediately understand why it works — the hook, the pacing, the clip choice, the emotional beat — and replicate that thinking, not just the edit?



If you answered an enthusiastic "YES," KEEP READING.



We run an international ecommerce brand selling both physical and digital products (ebooks, video courses) to English-speaking audiences in the US, UK, EU, and Australia. We're looking for a dedicated, full-time Video Editor to join our creative team and eventually grow into Head of Video Editing.



We're not chasing virality. Our goal is one thing: ads that stop the scroll and sell. Every video needs a hook strong enough to interrupt scrolling, and an edit that keeps attention high all the way through.



What you'll own:

-Sales-Focused Ad Production: Editing high-conversion Meta ads from scripts we provide — built to sell, not to go viral.

-AI Scene Generation & Recreation: Hands-on fluency with AI video tools (Google Flow, Higgsfield, and similar) to generate or recreate scenes and B-roll when what we have isn't enough — you don't wait for footage, you create it.

-Clip Curation & Sourcing: We'll provide a folder of selected B-rolls; if additional clips are needed, you source or generate them autonomously. High-quality only — traditional stock footage (Shutterstock, Envato, etc.) is strictly FORBIDDEN.

-Script-to-Screen Interpretation: We give you the hook and body copy; you d
 pacing, cuts, and visual rhythm to maximize watch-through and conversion.

-Strategic Input, Not Just Execution: We want a creative partner, not a pair of hands. You should actively propose new hooks, new formats, and new angles based on what you're seeing perform — not wait to be told what to test next.

-Constant Trend Awareness: You're the kind of editor who's already testing a new AI tool or ad format before we ask about it. Staying ahead of trends in short-form ad creative is part of the job, not an extra.

-Subtitle & Detail Precision: Clean, perfectly synced subtitles, no typos, no timing errors — this is an area where we accept zero compromise.

-Reliable, On-Time Delivery: Every deadline is a real deadline. Late deliveries disrupt the whole ad pipeline, and consistency here matters as much as editing skill.



Position Requirements:

-Full-time availability. This is not a 2-hours-a-day gig. If you're currently juggling 5–6 different clients and can't guarantee us priority and focus, please don't apply.

-Immediate or near-immediate start.

-2+ years of specific experience editing Meta Ads for ecommerce brands — physical product experience is fine, but experience with digital products (ebooks, courses, info-products) is a strong plus.

-Practical experience with AI video generation tools (Google Flow, Higgsfield, or equivalents) — this is not optional, it's core to how we produce content now.

-Fluent English — our team and all creative content are in English; you need to understand tone, nuance, and pacing at a native or near-native level.

-Strong grasp of hook, retention, and pacing — you should be able to explain why a cut works, not just execute it.

-A strategic, growth-minded approach — you think about what's next for the brand's creative, not just what's on today's task list.

-Weekend availability when needed, paid accordingly.

-Obsessive attention to detail. Subtitles, transitions, and timing must be clean. Mediocrity isn't tolerated on this team.

-Genuine passion for the craft of editing, and for staying current with where it's heading.



What We Offer:

-Performance bonuses tied to ad results, starting from month one.

-Real growth path to Head of Video Editing as the brand scales.

-Direct involvement in an international brand's creative strategy — your instincts and proposals shape what we test next.

title: Google Flow Video Editor Expert— Meta Ads Dropshipping
description:
Are YOU an experienced video editor who specializes in Meta Ads for ecommerce brands? Can you look at a competitor's winning ad and immediately understand why it works — the hook, the pacing, the clip choice, the emotional beat — and replicate that thinking, not just the edit?



If you answered an enthusiastic "YES," KEEP READING.



We run an international ecommerce brand selling both physical and digital products (ebooks, video courses) to English-speaking audiences in the US, UK, EU, and Australia. We're looking for a dedicated, full-time Video Editor to join our creative team and eventually grow into Head of Video Editing.



We're not chasing virality. Our goal is one thing: ads that stop the scroll and sell. Every video needs a hook strong enough to interrupt scrolling, and an edit that keeps attention high all the way through.



What you'll own:

-Sales-Focused Ad Production: Editing high-conversion Meta ads from scripts we provide — built to sell, not to go viral.

-AI Scene Generation & Recreation: Hands-on fluency with AI video tools (Google Flow, Higgsfield, and similar) to generate or recreate scenes and B-roll when what we have isn't enough — you don't wait for footage, you create it.

-Clip Curation & Sourcing: We'll provide a folder of selected B-rolls; if additional clips are needed, you source or generate them autonomously. High-quality only — traditional stock footage (Shutterstock, Envato, etc.) is strictly FORBIDDEN.

-Script-to-Screen Interpretation: We give you the hook and body copy; you d
 pacing, cuts, and visual rhythm to maximize watch-through and conversion.

-Strategic Input, Not Just Execution: We want a creative partner, not a pair of hands. You should actively propose new hooks, new formats, and new angles based on what you're seeing perform — not wait to be told what to test next.

-Constant Trend Awareness: You're the kind of editor who's already testing a new AI tool or ad format before we ask about it. Staying ahead of trends in short-form ad creative is part of the job, not an extra.

-Subtitle & Detail Precision: Clean, perfectly synced subtitles, no typos, no timing errors — this is an area where we accept zero compromise.

-Reliable, On-Time Delivery: Every deadline is a real deadline. Late deliveries disrupt the whole ad pipeline, and consistency here matters as much as editing skill.



Position Requirements:

-Full-time availability. This is not a 2-hours-a-day gig. If you're currently juggling 5–6 different clients and can't guarantee us priority and focus, please don't apply.

-Immediate or near-immediate start.

-2+ years of specific experience editing Meta Ads for ecommerce brands — physical product experience is fine, but experience with digital products (ebooks, courses, info-products) is a strong plus.

-Practical experience with AI video generation tools (Google Flow, Higgsfield, or equivalents) — this is not optional, it's core to how we produce content now.

-Fluent English — our team and all creative content are in English; you need to understand tone, nuance, and pacing at a native or near-native level.

-Strong grasp of hook, retention, and pacing — you should be able to explain why a cut works, not just execute it.

-A strategic, growth-minded approach — you think about what's next for the brand's creative, not just what's on today's task list.

-Weekend availability when needed, paid accordingly.

-Obsessive attention to detail. Subtitles, transitions, and timing must be clean. Mediocrity isn't tolerated on this team.

-Genuine passion for the craft of editing, and for staying current with where it's heading.



What We Offer:

-Performance bonuses tied to ad results, starting from month one.

-Real growth path to Head of Video Editing as the brand scales.

-Direct involvement in an international brand's creative strategy — your instincts and proposals shape what we test next.

title: E-commerce Video Editor (Meta Ads Specialist)
description:
Are YOU an experienced video editor specializing in Meta Ads for physical products and dropshipping? Can you look at a competitor’s winning ad and immediately understand how to replicate it technically, or transform a script into a winning creative using the most advanced AI tools? If you answered an enthusiastic “YES” to both questions above, KEEP READING.

We run multiple international companies in the ecommerce and education space and we’re looking for a Video Editor (Meta Ads Specialist) to join our creative team.

We need someone to take responsibility for:

Sales-Focused Ad Production: Crafting clean, high-conversion ads (1 to 5 minutes) including Mini-VSLs, AI-UGC, and "Product in Hand" content.

Asset Management & Sourcing: You will be provided with a folder of our selected B-rolls. However, if additional clips are needed, you must source them autonomously and innovatively. The use of traditional stock footage (Shutterstock, Envato, etc.) is strictly FORBIDDEN.

From Script to Finished Product: We provide the scripts; your job is to interpret them visually, choosing the right clips and editing them to create a dynamic, persuasive, and technically flawless product.

AI Tool Research & Implementation: This is your passion. You must stay constantly updated on new AI releases (editing, UGC avatars, video generation). In our weekly calls, we expect you to pitch new software that can revolutionize our workflow.

AI Asset Generation: Hands-on use of the AI Stack (Higgsfield, Sora 2, Veo 3, Arcads, MakeUGC) to create or enhance content.

Visual Optimization: Implementing textual hooks, kinetic typography, and scroll-stopping subtitles.

Position Requirements:

At least 2 years of specific experience: A solid background in Meta Ads for ecommerce brands. You must have worked as an editor for brands generating at least $10k/month in revenue. While respecting privacy, you will be asked to provide examples of these collaborations in the following stages.

Deep Passion for Innovation: This isn't just a job; you must love technology. We want an AI "killer" who stays ahead of the market.

title: Customer Service E-commerce (Fluent English, Weekend Availability Required)
description:
Are YOU an experienced customer service representative who can read the emotion behind a two-line
 and respond like a real, warm, thinking human being — not a copy-pasted bot reply? Can you handle a chargeback dispute on a digital product and actually have a shot at winning it, knowing exactly what evidence matters when there's no tracking number or delivery signature to show? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING.

We run multiple international companies in the ecommerce and digital education space, including a growing catalog of craft and DIY digital products, selling primarily to English-speaking customers in the US, UK, EU and Australia. We're looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our support team and take full ownership of the post-purchase customer experience.

We need someone to take responsibility for:

Inbox Ownership: Handling our daily support inbox end-to-end — order access issues, missing downloads, billing questions, refund requests, and general product questions — as the friendly, reliable human voice of the brand.

Retention-First Problem Solving: Before ever processing a refund, identifying and offering the right retention or bonus-bundle offer per our SOP. A refund is always the last resort, not the first move.

Chargeback & Dispute Defense: Responding to chargebacks and payment disputes on digital products with the right evidence (delivery confirmation, access logs, communication history, terms accepted at checkout) — you understand this is a different game than physical-product disputes, and you know a genuinely high win-rate claim doesn't exist in this space.

Template Adaptation, Not Scripting: We provide a complete SOP with
 templates for every common scenario. Your job is to use them as a base and adapt the tone naturally to each customer — never robotic, never obviously AI-generated or copy-pasted.

Escalation Judgment: Knowing exactly when a situation (legal threat, unusual request outside our templates, a case that just doesn't smell right) needs to be flagged to us instead of improvised.

Daily Reporting: Keeping a simple log of ticket volume and any recurring issues you notice, so we can fix problems at the source.

Position Requirements:

At least 2 years of specific customer service experience for digital products — not physical/shipping-based ecommerce. You must know the practical difference between a refund and a chargeback, and have direct experience responding to disputes where a tracking number isn't an option.

Fluent English, 9/10 or above: natural, native-sounding phrasing — not translated-sounding sentences. As part of the application, you'll be asked to record a short 60-second video or voice response to a question you haven't seen in advance. This isn't optional — written answers alone won't be considered.

A real thinking mind, not an AI-generated response: we will read your written answers closely, and generic, overly polished, ChatGPT-flavored replies will be filtered out immediately. We want your judgment, not a prompt's.

Comfortable with our tools: Google Drive (sharing, permissions, troubleshooting access errors), PDF delivery, and a shared support inbox/helpdesk.

Availability & Commitment: This role requires coverage 7 days a week, including Saturday and Sunday — no exceptions, no "9-to-5, Monday-Friday" mentality. Minimum 3 hours/day, structured as short check-ins spread across your day (morning / afternoon / evening, your own local time zone). Please tell us honestly: how many other clients/hours are you currently working, and would you see this growing toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months?

Obsessive Precision & Anti-Mediocrity: correct order numbers, correct links, zero copy-paste mistakes in a customer's name or order details. Mediocrity is not allowed in our team.

What We Offer:

A complete, ready-to-use Customer Service SOP with templates for every common scenario, plus clear escalation guidelines — you'll never be guessing.

A short, paid trial period before any long-term commitment.

Career Growth: real potential to become the lead/only customer service representative across our full catalog as it expands, with performance-based rate increases and a path toward full-time.

Screening Questions (Upwork):

Please write a 3-4 sentence sample reply to this customer message: "Hi, I purchased the ebook bundle two days ago but never received the download
. Can you help?"

Have you handled disputes/chargebacks on digital products before? If so, roughly what percentage have you been able to win, and what evidence/approach did you use? (Be honest — we're checking for real experience, not a number.)

What's your current workload with other clients (hours/week), and do you see yourself moving toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months?

This role requires 7-day-a-week availability, minimum 3 hours/day split into short check-ins across your day — not Mon-Fri only, and not one continuous block. Please confirm you're comfortable with this on an ongoing basis, and share your proposed check-in times in your own time zone.

To Apply: Include the sample reply above directly in your application, along with a brief note on your relevant experience. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a short 60-second video or voice response before moving forward.

title: Full-Time & Part-Time Customer Care & Sales Support VA (GoHighLevel)
description:
Hi! I'm Yas of HIDARI Group, a growing Canadian business optimization and implementation company.



We’re growing our customer care team to support homeowners across Western Canada as they choose and install blinds, shades, shutters, drapery, and motorized window coverings.



I’m looking for a warm, confident and highly organized Customer Care & Sales Support VA who knows GoHighLevel (LeadConnector) and loves talking to customers on the phone.



This is NOT a CRM build or automation role. The pipelines, workflows and follow-up sequences are already set up.



I’m looking for someone who can work inside that system every day: call new leads within minutes, book in-home consultations, follow up on quotes, answer customer messages, and keep every record accurate.



You will be working directly with our office team, who will train you and be your day-to-day point of contact.

Your primary goal will be simple:



Make sure no lead, customer, quote or service request falls through the cracks, and keep the consultation calendar full.

What You’ll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will include:



- Responding to new leads, missed calls, texts and
s within 5–10 minutes

- Calling new leads to book free in-home consultations

- Collecting and entering complete booking details (contact info, service address, number of windows, budget, products of interest, preferred date and time)

- Following up with leads who haven’t booked yet

- Calling and texting customers about open quotes after their consultation

- Answering general questions and finding out what’s holding a customer back

- Managing the CRM Conversations inbox throughout your shift

- Reviewing customer history, notes and tasks before every call or message

- Updating notes, tasks and opportunity stages after every interaction

- Responding to Google reviews with professional, personalized replies

- Tracking warranty, repair and service requests until they’re resolved

- Reviewing completed installations and closing files once every checklist is done

- Escalating pricing, complaints, warranty approvals and installation issues to the office team

- Preparing a weekly report on leads, bookings, quotes and open issues



The system already sends automated follow-ups. Your job is to add the human touch: the call, the thoughtful reply, and the follow-through.



Experience We’re Looking For: 

Hands-on GoHighLevel (LeadConnector) experience is required.



Please apply only if you have used GoHighLevel day to day: managing opportunities and pipelines, working the Conversations inbox, booking into calendars, and updating contacts, notes and tasks.



We’re specifically looking for someone with experience in appointment setting, inside sales support or customer service for North American customers, ideally in home services (window coverings, roofing, HVAC, solar, renovations or similar).



We are NOT looking for someone whose only GHL experience is building funnels or automations without talking to customers.

You should have:



- Excellent spoken English with clear, warm and confident phone communication

- Excellent written English for texts,
s and review replies

- Previous experience calling customers in Canada and/or the United States

- Previous appointment-setting or sales follow-up experience

- Daily, hands-on use of GoHighLevel/LeadConnector (pipelines, Conversations, calendars, tasks, reviews, dialer)

- Enough understanding of GHL workflows to avoid double-messaging customers or triggering the wrong automation

- Ability to handle several conversations at once without missing details

- Strong attention to detail and consistent note-taking habits

- Good judgment about what you can handle and what needs escalating

- Basic Google Sheets skills for weekly reporting

- Reliable internet with a backup connection and backup power

- A quiet, professional workspace and a good-quality noise-cancelling headset



Experience with home improvement or window covering products, franchise businesses, the LeadConnector mobile app, and handling warranty or service requests is an asset.



The Person I’m Looking For



Personality matters to me.



You’ll be the voice homeowners hear when they first reach out. You’ll also be the person who makes sure they’re looked after long after their blinds are installed.



You should be friendly, patient, dependable and comfortable taking ownership. If a quote has gone quiet, I want you to follow up. If a customer mentions a problem in passing, I want you to log it and make sure someone deals with it. If a task is sitting open, I want you to close it or flag it.



I’m not looking for pushy sales tactics.



I’m looking for someone who can confidently say:

“Hi Sarah, I’m following up on the quote from your consultation last week. Did you have a chance to look it over, or are there any questions I can help with?”



From there, you should be comfortable having a real conversation, listening for what’s holding them back, and guiding them to the next step.



Hours & Position

We’re hiring for both full-time and part-time positions:



Shift

Weekdays



Mountain Time

Mon–Fri, 3:00pm–8:00pm



Philippine Time (Nov–Mar)

Tue–Sat, 6:00am–11:00am



Philippine Time (Mar–Nov)

Tue–Sat, 5:00am–10:00am



Shift

Weekends



Mountain Time

Sat–Sun, 9:00am–6:00pm



Philippine Time (Nov–Mar)

Sun–Mon, 12:00am–9:00am



Philippine Time (Mar–Nov)

Sat–Sun 11:00pm – Sun–Mon 8:00am



Philippine times move one hour earlier during North American daylight saving time.



You’ll start with 2 weeks of paid training, shadowing our office team and learning their products, policies and GoHighLevel setup. You’ll then manage the role alongside them.



The busy season runs March to August, so you’ll be fully trained and confident before the volume picks up.

This position will initially begin as a 3-month pilot, with the opportunity to become a long-term role if we’re a great fit and the position is producing results.



A confidentiality agreement and security training are required before you start.



How to Apply: 

Please don’t send me a generic application. I’d genuinely like to learn a little about you.

In your application, please answer the following:



1. How many years have you used GoHighLevel/LeadConnector, and which features did you use daily?

power?

9. Please send your updated CV or portfolio for our reference.



Applications without hands-on GoHighLevel experience will not be considered.

Lastly, please note that we will only entertain applications submitted through our official job postings on OnlineJobs.ph. 

Thank you for your understanding.

title: Ecommerce Virtual Assistant (Customer Support, Operations & AI)
description:
Are YOU an experienced ecommerce support professional who can answer a difficult customer with care, and also keep an eye on orders, suppliers and stock like the founder's right hand? Can you use Claude to automate repetitive work, and take initiative without waiting to be told? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING.



We run multiple international ecommerce brands selling both digital products (ebooks, templates, online courses) and physical products, primarily to English-speaking customers in the US, UK, EU and Australia. We're looking for an Ecommerce Virtual Assistant who will handle customer support and follow our day-to-day operations, as a true right hand to the founder.



This is not a role where you answer tickets and wait for instructions. Customer support is a core part of the job, but when the inbox is quiet you move on to operations, suppliers and projects.



We need someone to take responsibility for:



Customer Support: Handling our support inbox end-to-end (order issues, shipping and delivery questions, missing downloads, billing, refund requests, product questions) as the friendly, reliable human voice of the brand.

Retention & Disputes: Offering the right solution before any refund, per our SOP, and responding quickly to chargebacks and payment disputes with the right evidence.

Operations Follow-Up: Following orders, stock levels and delivery issues, spotting problems before customers do, and keeping a simple daily log of what needs attention.

Supplier Communication: Talking to our suppliers about stock, deliveries and problems, following up, and negotiating when needed.

Automation: Using Claude, Claude Code, connectors and other tools to automate repetitive tickets and manual tasks, and proposing new automations on your own initiative.

AI Content Support: Creating product and marketing images with ChatGPT (or similar tools), producing ebooks with Claude, and generating interactive content with AppLovin tools.

Founder Support: Taking over tasks the founder currently does by hand, and anticipating what's needed next.



Position Requirements:



At least 2 years of customer support experience in ecommerce. You have answered real customer tickets for real stores. Experience with dispute/chargeback handling and with digital products is a plus.

Experience in other ecommerce tasks: you have worked on at least some of these for previous companies: supplier communication, stock or inventory, order management, product listings, ads support, store operations. Tell us exactly what you've done.

Hands-on experience with Claude: you use it regularly for real work. Experience with Claude Code, connectors or automations is strongly preferred, and you'll be asked to describe real examples.

Experience with AI image generation (ChatGPT or similar) for product or marketing visuals.

Initiative and ownership: you notice problems, propose solutions and often build them yourself.

Excellent written English: warm, natural and professional.

Comfortable with ecommerce tools: a helpdesk (Gorgias or similar), Shopify, Google Drive, and order tracking platforms.

Reliability: customers and suppliers depend on you, so consistency matters more than anything on a CV. Starting part-time, with room to grow toward full-time.

Precision: correct order numbers, correct links, no copy-paste mistakes.



What We Offer:



A complete Customer Service SOP with templates and escalation guidelines, so you're never guessing.

A short, paid trial period before any long-term commitment.

Real growth: more responsibility, more hours and performance-based rate increases as the role expands.

Ownership and variety: you'll work with the AI stack, build automations and see the results of your ideas inside a real, growing business.



Screening Questions (Upwork):



How many years have you answered customer tickets in ecommerce? Which stores or types of products, which channels 
, chat) and which tools? Have you handled disputes/chargebacks, and on digital products, physical products or both? In your experience, how many tickets can one person realistically handle in an 8-hour day, and what does that number depend on?

Besides answering customers, which other tasks have you done for previous companies (suppliers, stock, orders, listings, ads, images, ebooks, automations, operations)? For each one, tell us how long you did it and give one concrete example of what you handled.

Have you used Claude, Claude Code or other tools to automate a business process? Describe one real example: what it did, how you built it, and the result.



To Apply: Please answer the screening questions above directly in your application, with specific examples. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short application form.

title: Client Account Manager – Digital Marketing Agency (UK Hours)
description:
About us

SEInnovations is a lead generation agency for UK care providers. We run
 and Instagram ads that bring families looking for care straight to home care, live-in care and supported living businesses. For many of them we also build a GoHighLevel CRM that follows up every enquiry automatically.



We have worked with over 40 care providers, including Bluebird Care, Caremark, Home Instead and Clarity offices as well as independent home care businesses. We are a small, fast team run by our two founders: Stepan runs campaigns, systems and operations, and Henry runs sales.



The role

You will be the person our clients talk to. From the day a client pays, you join their WhatsApp group and own the day to day relationship: answering questions, keeping them updated, handling complaints and following up payments.

We build and run every campaign and make all the ads. You are the link between us and the client, so they always know what is happening and we always know how their enquiries are going.



What you will do

• Reply first in every client WhatsApp group during UK hours, quickly and in clear, professional English.

• Answer clients' everyday questions, from how Meta bills their card to why an enquiry did not pick up the phone, using our SOP and the Claude projects we give you.

• Keep clients moving through setup: onboarding details,
 and Instagram pages, ad approvals and the card on their ad account.

• Keep clients following up their enquiries fast, and collect their feedback on lead quality so we can improve their ads.

• Handle complaints calmly, and bring anything serious to Stepan and Henry straight away.

• Follow up the invoices we send, and any failed card payments on clients' ad accounts that stop their ads running.

• Send a weekly update on every client to our team WhatsApp group.



What you need

• Experience in a client facing role, such as account management, client success or customer support, ideally for an agency or a service business.

• Strong written English. You will be writing to UK business owners all day, so spelling, grammar and tone matter.

• Fast and reliable on WhatsApp across UK working hours. Our clients are used to hearing back in minutes, not hours.

• Calm, polite and firm with difficult clients. You stay factual, never argue and never over promise.

• Organised. You look after many clients at once without anything slipping.

• A laptop, a stable internet connection and working knowledge of Google Sheets and Google Drive.



Nice to have

• A basic understanding of
 and Instagram ads, enough to explain billing, ad reviews and lead forms to a client.

• GoHighLevel experience, since most of our clients use our GoHighLevel CRM and ask about it.

• Experience with UK care, healthcare or other local service businesses, and a feel for the difference between home care, live-in care and supported living.

• Using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in your day to day work. We will give you Claude projects set up for our work.

What good looks like

Clients hear back from you within minutes. They follow up their enquiries fast and tell us how each one went. Setup never stalls waiting on the client. Invoices get paid on time. Nothing serious ever reaches a client before it reaches us.



When you apply, tell us

• Your client facing experience: what kind of clients, how many at once, and over which channels.

• How you have handled clients directly over WhatsApp or similar.

• That you can work UK hours, and which time zone you are in.

title: Loan Closing Processor (Private Money Lending) — Long-Term, Full-Time, US Hours
description:
We're a U.S.-based private money lending company, and we're hiring a Loan Closing Processor to run borrower intake and get deal files clean and ready for underwriting.



This is a long-term, full-time role with a stable team. You'll work directly with borrowers and U.S. leadership inside our CRM (GoHighLevel) using documented SOPs. It is not a bank mortgage job — we do short-term, asset-based loans to real estate investors: bridge funding, gap funding, first- and second-position loans, and creative deals.



Hours: 10am–7pm CST (Central Time), Monday–Friday

Rate: $4–6/hr (depending on experience)



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



Borrower intake & pipeline

- Respond to every new borrower application the same business day

- Follow up until missing items are collected — no stale files, no unanswered leads

- Keep CRM stages accurate and current

- Flag urgent or high-priority deals to leadership immediately



File organization

- Build and maintain borrower folders in Google Drive per our naming conventions

- Collect the full document set before escalating: purchase agreement, rehab budget/scope, ARV comps, property photos, borrower ID, LLC docs, verified HUDs, insurance, and a stated exit strategy

- Submit complete, clearly labeled files that are ready for underwriting



Pre-qualification & SOPs

- Screen deals against our lending criteria before escalating (LTV, borrower spread, combined leverage, close timeline)

- Route deals outside our criteria to our referral process

- Escalate borderline files — never force one through



Communication

- Daily end-of-day update: completed, pending, needs attention

- Professional written communication with U.S. borrowers

- Surface open loops and problems proactively, before you're asked



WHAT WE REQUIRE

- A U.S. real estate lending foundation — REQUIRED. U.S. banking, mortgage, or lending experience is what we're looking for — but it must include the real estate component: mortgage processing, property/real estate loans, non-QM / hard-money / private lending, or real estate loan documents. General banking with no real estate exposure will not qualify. We are not training this from scratch — you need the foundation before day one.

- Excellent written English — this role lives in
 and CRM notes

- Genuinely strong attention to detail (we will test this)

- Experience managing many open items at once without dropping follow-ups

- Comfortable working U.S. business hours (10am–7pm CST, Mon–Fri)

- Reliable daily availability and consistent EOD reporting



NICE TO HAVE

- Private money, hard money, or creative real estate (subject-to, seller finance) exposure

- Familiarity with ARV, LTV, HUDs, and exit strategy

- Experience pulling comps (PropStream, Redfin)

- GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AT 90 DAYS

Every lead answered. Clean CRM records. Files reaching leadership complete the first time. Borrowers feel informed. Leadership isn't chasing or fixing anything.



HOW TO APPLY

Put the word "Closing" in your application message so we know you read this all the way through.



Then send your resume plus short answers to these three:



Briefly describe your hands-on experience with U.S. loans — mortgage processing, non-QM / private / hard-money lending, or real estate loan documents. Which loan types and systems have you worked with?



Applications without the keyword or the three answers will not be reviewed.

title: Transaction Coordinator – Non-QM Mortgage (DSCR / Bank Statement / Investor Loans) | AI-Forward Team
description:
We're MV Corporate, a U.S.-based real estate, private lending, and investment company. We fund investor loans (DSCR, bank statement, bridge, fix-and-flip) and we run on an AI-powered team. We're hiring a Transaction Coordinator to keep every file moving from contract to clear-to-close. You'll be the person borrowers, brokers, lenders, and title companies count on for a straight answer.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

We use AI tools every day for inbox triage, condition tracking, document review, and drafting. We are not looking for someone to retype checklists. We want someone who looks at a file, figures out what is actually missing, uses AI to move faster, and then picks up the phone to close the gap. A sharp coordinator who embraces AI will outperform a veteran who resists it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own non-QM and investor loan files from submission through clear-to-close, handling several files each month

- Track conditions, deadlines, and contract milestones; know what's missing before anyone asks

- Call and
 borrowers, brokers, lenders, title/escrow, insurance, and appraisal contacts

- Review documents for completeness: spot missing pages, signature errors, and mismatched entity details before underwriting does

- Keep GoHighLevel and Google Drive accurate and current

- Use AI tools to draft updates, summarize documents, and automate repeat tasks

- Send a daily end-of-day update: done, pending, needs attention

- Flag at-risk files early, with a recommendation, not just a question



WHAT WE GIVE YOU

- AI tools and workflows already built for the work

- Full SOPs and video walkthroughs

- Your own CRM login and a company

- Training on how we do things, plus real autonomy. We care that files close.



WHAT WE NEED

- 2+ years of U.S. real estate experience, residential mainly

- Background in loan processing at a lending bank, a mortgage office or brokerage, or a real estate firm (bank-level processing experience is a big plus)

- Ability to process several loan files a month with accuracy and speed

- Working knowledge of non-QM, DSCR, or investor loans, and TRID/closing timelines

- Experience with an LOS and a CRM (GoHighLevel is a plus)

- Excellent spoken and written English; this role is on the phone with U.S. borrowers every day

- Comfort using AI tools, and the curiosity to keep learning them

- Organized, decisive, and thick-skinned; you follow up without reminders

- Reliable internet, backup power, and a quiet workspace

- Available during U.S. Central Time business hours



NICE TO HAVE

Entity-borrowing knowledge (LLCs, trusts), title/escrow coordination, private or hard money exposure.



AUTHORITY BOUNDARY

You coordinate and organize. You do not approve loans, quote terms, or give lending advice. Those decisions stay with leadership.



GROWTH

Strong performers move into full pipeline ownership and team-lead roles as we grow.



HOW TO APPLY (follow this exactly)

1. Start your message with the word TRACKER.

2. Tell us where you worked (lending bank, mortgage office, or real estate firm), your years of U.S. residential experience, and roughly how many loan files you process per month.

3. Describe a time you chased a missing condition or document to the finish. What did you do?

4. How do you use AI in your work today? Name the tool, the task, and what it saved you.

5. Include your resume link and a 60-second voice or video introduction.



Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed.

title: Loan Processor / Lending Operations Coordinator
description:
We are a U.S.-based private money lending company that provides short-term, asset-based loans to real estate investors. We focus on first- and second-position loans, bridge funding, gap funding, and creative real estate transactions.

We value clean execution, capital protection, and professional communication.



Role Overview

We are hiring a Loan Processor / Lending Operations Coordinator to run borrower intake, manage our loan pipeline, and prepare deal files for underwriting. This role is the operational backbone of our lending business and works directly with borrowers, brokers, and internal leadership.



This is not a bank mortgage role. You will support private money and creative real estate deals using a CRM pipeline (GoHighLevel) and documented internal SOPs.



Key Responsibilities



Borrower Intake & Pipeline Management

Respond to new borrower applications and CRM inquiries the same business day

Send first-touch outreach to all new borrower leads promptly

Follow up consistently to collect missing application items

Accurately track and update borrower status through the correct CRM pipeline stages

Keep the pipeline clean — no stale files, no unanswered leads

Flag urgent or high-priority deals for leadership without delay





Loan File Organization & Documentation

Create and maintain borrower folders in Google Drive per company naming conventions

Collect ALL required documents before escalating a file: purchase agreement, rehab budget/scope of work, ARV comps, property photos, borrower ID, LLC documents (Operating Agreement + proof of good standing), verified HUDs, insurance, and a clearly stated exit strategy

Track all documents and file status accurately in the CRM

Submit complete, clearly labeled files that are ready for underwriting





SOP Adherence & Deal Pre-Qualification

Pre-qualify deals against our lending criteria before escalating (private money vs. hard money vs. hybrid)

Apply our quick-screen criteria accurately (LTV, borrower spread, combined leverage, close timeline)

Verify all non-negotiable borrower requirements

Route deals that fall outside our criteria to our referral process per SOP

Escalate unclear or borderline deals to leadership — never force a file through



Communication & Reporting



Provide consistent daily end-of-day (EOD) updates: completed, pending, needs attention

Communicate professionally and clearly with borrowers throughout the loan process

Proactively surface open loops, urgent items, and potential issues without being asked

Log all borrower conversations and decisions in the CRM accurately and promptly



Important Authority Boundaries



You will prepare, organize, and pre-qualify deals — but you will not approve loans, set terms, or make funding decisions. All approvals and final decisions stay with internal leadership.

Requirements



2+ years experience in real estate transactions, loan processing, or lending support

Strong attention to detail and organization

Excellent written and spoken English

Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based clients

Ability to manage multiple deals at once without dropping follow-ups

Experience using CRMs and pipeline-based systems

Reliable daily availability and consistent EOD reporting



Nice to Have (Not Required)



Private money, hard money, or creative real estate (subject-to, seller finance) experience

Familiarity with real estate investing terminology and underwriting basics (ARV, LTV, HUDs, exit strategy)

Experience pulling comps (e.g., PropStream, Redfin)

GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience



What Success Looks Like



Clean, accurate CRM records with every lead answered

Deals move smoothly with minimal rework

Files reach leadership complete and ready for underwriting

Borrowers feel informed and supported

Leadership does not need to fix or chase files



Growth Path



Strong performers move into expanded responsibility: full pipeline management without daily supervision, loan-file audits, lead generation in investor communities, weekly pipeline and loan-admin reporting, and coordinating document requests with borrowers and title companies.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction explaining your relevant experience and why you're an excellent fit for this role. Include the word "Lending" in your application message so we know you read this fully.

title: Bankruptcy Case Manager (US Law Firm) - Trustee Documents & Deadlines
description:
READ THIS FIRST

To apply, start your message with the word TRUSTEE and answer the four questions at the end. Applications that skip this get deleted unread. This job is about following instructions exactly and on time, so the application is the first test.



WHO WE ARE

Van Horn Law Group, P.A. is a bankruptcy law firm in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. We file Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 consumer and business cases in four federal court districts. About 100 people work here, including 15 attorneys. We have been doing this for over a decade and we file cases every single week.



THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE

After we file a client's bankruptcy case, the trustee starts asking for documents on a deadline, and you are the person who makes sure every single one arrives on time.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Own a caseload of filed Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 cases from the filing date all the way to discharge.

Track every trustee document request and every court deadline on your cases. Nothing gets lost, nothing gets late.

Chase clients by
, text and phone until the documents actually arrive. Politely, persistently, and without letting anything sit.

Assemble and submit document packages to the trustees through their portals.

Get clients ready for their 341 meeting of creditors so they show up on time, with ID, knowing what to expect.

Confirm the required credit counseling and financial management courses are completed and the certificates are in the file.

Escalate to the supervising attorney the moment a deadline looks at risk. Early and often. We would much rather hear about a problem a week out than the day after.

Keep every case status current in our system so anyone can see where a file stands in ten seconds.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Follow up is the entire job. We need someone who cannot stand an open item. If a client ignores three
s, you find another way to reach them. If a document looks wrong, you catch it before the trustee does. If a deadline is six days out, it is already on your mind.

This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do. Cases fall apart quietly when nobody is chasing, and a missed deadline can get a client's case dismissed. That is why this job matters and why we pay well for it.

You should be comfortable being the calm, organized person telling a stressed client for the fourth time that we still need their bank statement, and having them thank you for it.



REQUIRED

At least 2 years chasing documents, payments or information from people against a deadline. US law firm, collections, insurance claims follow up, medical billing and accounts receivable, mortgage processing, or title work all count. US bankruptcy experience is a big plus but it is not required.

Excellent spoken and written English. You will be on the phone and on
 with US clients every day.

A real system for tracking deadlines. In your application, tell us what it is.

Available during US Eastern business hours.

A reliable computer, backup power, a quiet place to take calls, and stable internet of at least 25 Mbps. We will ask for a speed test screenshot.

Able to sign a confidentiality agreement and work inside our secure systems. Our clients' financial information never leaves them.



IMPORTANT ABOUT THIS ROLE

You will never give clients legal advice. You collect documents, confirm dates, explain our process, and route every legal question to an attorney. We will train you on exactly where that line sits, and we take it seriously.



NICE TO HAVE

Experience with Chapter 7 or Chapter 13 trustee document requests.

Experience with 341 meeting preparation.

Experience with a US law firm case management system.



WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive monthly salary in USD, paid on time, every time.

Paid time off plus Philippine holidays.

HMO after the probationary period.

Full paid training on US bankruptcy procedure and our systems. If you have the discipline, we will teach you the law part.

Real advancement. Our senior Philippine team members lead other people and are paid accordingly.

A long-term seat. We are hiring someone we expect to still be here in five years.



SALARY

We pay at the top of that range for someone who has done US bankruptcy post-filing work before.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word TRUSTEE. Then answer these four questions in your own words. Please do not use AI to write your answers. We read a lot of these and we can tell.

1. Describe a job where you were responsible for chasing people for documents, payments or information on a deadline. How many were you handling at once, and exactly how did you track them?

2. A client has ignored three
s and one phone call, and the document is due in four days. Walk us through exactly what you do next, step by step.

3. What tools have you used to track deadlines and case status, and what did you like or dislike about them?

4. What hours can you work in Philippine time, and are you comfortable being on the phone with US clients?

Attach your resume and tell us your expected monthly salary in USD. We reply to every applicant who follows these instructions.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Location: Philippines

Employment type: Full-time, 6 month Contract to Hire as full time



Solvera is recruiting on behalf of a US-headquartered client with operations across the United States and ASEAN. Our client provides digital, web, and creative services that help businesses strengthen their brands, reach customers, and grow.



Our client is seeking an Executive Assistant to support its CEO and another senior leader, helping them focus their time on the decisions, relationships, and priorities that matter most.



The Opportunity

Entrepreneurial leaders often have more ideas and opportunities than hours in the day. Meetings compete with decisions, priorities shift, and important actions can lose momentum when nobody owns the follow-through.



This role brings clarity to that environment. You will help the CEO and a senior leader make deliberate choices about their time, keep track of commitments, and ensure the right people have what they need to move work forward.



You will manage complex calendars and communications, but you will also look ahead: spotting competing priorities, chasing blockers, preparing leaders for decisions, and improving the systems behind the work. We’re looking for someone who can think quickly, exercise sound judgement, and bring order without slowing the business down.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES (Not absolute, CEO will work with you to identify which areas you can own): 



1) Executive support and calendar management

- Manage the CEO’s and senior leader’s calendars, balancing strategic priorities, client commitments, internal meetings, and time for focused work.

- Assess meeting requests, clarify their purpose and urgency, and recommend what should be scheduled, delegated, rescheduled, or declined.

- Coordinate meetings across time zones, ensuring participants have the relevant information and materials in advance.

- Prepare concise daily and weekly schedules that highlight priorities, decisions, deadlines, and potential conflicts.

- Anticipate changes and reorganize schedules quickly when business needs shift.

- Coordinate travel, itineraries, appointments, and related logistics when required.



2) Priorities, actions, and follow-through

- Maintain a clear view of the executives’ priorities, commitments, and deadlines.

- Translate meetings and discussions into action items with owners and due dates.

- Follow up with stakeholders, identify blockers, and escalate issues that need executive attention.

- Help leaders distinguish urgent matters from work that can be delegated, deferred, or handled by others.

- Prepare brief status updates so executives can see what is progressing, what is at risk, and where a decision is needed.

- Keep track of ideas and new opportunities, helping leaders determine the next step and owner.



3) Executive communications

- Monitor and organize executive correspondence as authorized, flagging urgent matters and bringing relevant context to the leaders’ attention.

- Draft and, where authorized, send
s and responses on behalf of the CEO and senior leader.

- Communicate professionally with clients, partners, and internal teams, adapting to the executive’s voice and the situation.

- Follow up on outstanding requests and ensure correspondence is acknowledged and actioned.

- Handle sensitive information with discretion and sound judgement.

- Know when to respond independently and when to seek direction or escalate.



4) Systems, automation, and continuous improvement

- Review recurring administrative work and identify opportunities to simplify or automate it.

- Design and maintain practical systems for tracking priorities, meetings, actions, documents, and follow-ups.

- Use digital tools and automation to reduce manual work and improve visibility across executive commitments.

- Set up or improve templates, reminders, workflows, and dashboards that help the leaders and their teams stay organized.

- Explore appropriate AI and productivity tools, applying them thoughtfully while protecting confidential information.

- Document processes so they are easy to maintain and improve.



5) Meeting preparation and executive coordination

- Prepare agendas, briefing notes, background information, and relevant documents before meetings.

- Capture key decisions and actions, and ensure follow-ups reach the right people.

- Coordinate with managers and project owners to obtain updates, reports, and materials.

- Help prepare presentations, correspondence, and executive summaries.

- Maintain organized files and ensure executives can find information quickly.

- Coordinate across teams to keep leadership priorities moving.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: 

- At least five years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Senior Executive Assistant, Executive Business Partner, or in a similar role supporting senior leaders.

- Experience managing complex calendars, competing priorities, and communications for executives.

- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to draft clear, professional correspondence on behalf of senior leaders.

- Strong organizational skills and a proven ability to follow through until work is completed.

- Experience using digital tools to improve workflows, manage information, or automate recurring tasks.

- Confidence working with senior stakeholders and following up on overdue commitments.

- Sound judgement, discretion, and the ability to handle sensitive information.

- Ability to anticipate needs, identify problems early, and propose practical solutions.

- Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change.

- Proficiency in common productivity tools, including calendars, spreadsheets, presentations, and shared document systems.



What will distinguish candidates:

- Experience supporting an entrepreneurial CEO, founder, or senior leader in a growing business.

- Demonstrated examples of automations or systems they have introduced that saved time or improved follow-through.

- Experience supporting more than one executive and managing competing requests.

- Familiarity with project management tools, workflow automation platforms, and AI productivity tools.

- Experience coordinating across international teams and time zones.

- Ability to turn complex information into concise briefings and action plans.



Location, work eligibility, and availability: 

- We welcome applications from Filipino and expatriate candidates who are legally authorized to work in the Philippines. 

- Available for regular working-hour overlap with US Pacific Time to support the executives and coordinate with international teams. The agreed schedule will accommodate Pacific daylight saving changes.

- Willing to attend in-person meetings or travel as required.

title: AI Fashion Video Creator for TikTok Shop (Short Silent Videos)
description:
I run TikTok Shop accounts in Thailand and I'm looking for someone to create short AI-generated fashion product videos for me.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Create silent, music-driven vertical (9:16) videos, 8 to 12 seconds long, using AI video and virtual try-on tools

- Recreate viral TikTok Shop fashion videos (US or any market) from reference links I send: same hook, pacing and structure

- Use our real product photos and clips so color, fit and fabric look accurate

- Use the AI avatar I provide (an Asian woman). Do not create or use any real person's likeness

- Deliver ready-to-post videos through Google Drive and make quick revisions when asked



WHAT I HANDLE

- Reference videos, product photos and key benefits

- Thai text overlays, music choice and posting



TIKTOK SHOP AI CONTENT RULES (REQUIRED)

Every video must follow TikTok Shop's current AI-generated content policy. At minimum:

- The product must be shown accurately (true color, fit, fabric, details). No misleading visuals

- Videos that are fully or heavily AI-generated must be clearly marked as AI, so build them so they can be labeled as AI-generated

- No fake reviews, fabricated endorsements, invented results or exaggerated claims

- No real person's face or voice used without their permission, and no celebrity or lookalike likeness

- No AI-generated voices or fake narration passed off as a real person

- Every video must have real motion. No static slideshows, still images or looping clips

- No copyrighted or trademarked material (logos, characters, brand footage) that we don't own

If you are unsure whether something is allowed, ask me before making it. Videos that break these rules will not be accepted.



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience making AI product, fashion or UGC-style videos (portfolio required)

- Skilled with AI video tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Veo or similar) and CapCut or similar editing

- Familiar with TikTok Shop's AI content policy, or willing to read it before starting



VOLUME

Start with 1 video a day, with room to grow if results are good.



PAID TRIAL

First 3 videos are a paid trial so we can see your quality and workflow.



TO APPLY, PLEASE ANSWER

1. Which AI video and try-on tools do you use?

2. Link 2 or 3 AI fashion or product videos you've made.

title: Director of International Brands & Retail Markets
description:
Location: Philippines, with local and international travel as needed

Employment type: Full-time, Contract to Hire



Solvera is recruiting on behalf of a US-headquartered client with operations across the United States and ASEAN. With an established presence in the Philippines, our client is expanding its portfolio of international brands, products, and supply solutions across consumer, institutional, and commercial markets.



We are seeking a commercially accomplished Director of International Brands & Retail Markets to lead brand acquisition, partnerships, market entry, and retail expansion.



This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can identify brands with strong market potential, negotiate sound commercial agreements, and build the channels and operating discipline needed to deliver profitable growth.



The Opportunity

You will lead the development and performance of the international brands and retail portfolio, from identifying potential partners and securing commercial rights through launch, distribution, and ongoing growth.



Working closely with executive leadership, you will develop the portfolio strategy, build retail and distribution relationships, and make investment recommendations supported by clear commercial analysis.



Key responsibilities

1) Portfolio strategy and international brand partnerships

Develop the portfolio strategy, identifying priority categories, brands, customer segments, and markets.

Identify and engage international brand owners seeking representation or expansion in the Philippines and selected ASEAN markets.

Evaluate distribution, licensing, franchise, and other commercial partnership opportunities.

Prepare business cases covering market demand, competition, pricing, investment requirements, risks, and expected returns.

Lead negotiations on territory, exclusivity, distribution and channel rights, purchase commitments, marketing support, payment terms, and performance obligations.

Assess partner credibility, supply reliability, product suitability, and contractual risks with Finance, Legal, and Operations.

Build strong relationships with international principals and monitor delivery against agreed commitments.

Recommend when to invest, expand, renegotiate, reposition, or exit a brand.



2) Market entry and brand development

Develop market-entry plans covering positioning, assortment, pricing, route to market, launch investment, and financial targets.

Translate international brand standards into locally relevant commercial execution.

Coordinate product readiness, regulatory requirements, supply arrangements, marketing, and channel activation.

Establish launch milestones, budgets, ownership, and performance measures.

Use customer insights, sales data, and competitor analysis to refine product selection and positioning.

Evaluate expansion into selected ASEAN markets, accounting for differences in demand, regulation, distribution, and channel economics.

Manage brand performance beyond launch, with attention to sustained sales, repeat demand, and viable margins.



3) Retail, distribution, and channel growth

Develop the appropriate mix of retail, wholesale, distribution, e-commerce, marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and institutional channels.

Build and maintain relationships with retail groups, distributors, commercial partners, and strategic accounts.

Negotiate listings, trading terms, promotions, and channel agreements that support profitable growth.

Set channel-specific pricing, assortment, service standards, and performance expectations.

Evaluate physical retail opportunities against location economics, investment requirements, payback, and operating capacity.

Maintain pricing discipline and manage channel conflict.

Improve sales productivity, sell-through, customer retention, and repeat purchasing.

Coordinate institutional or government opportunities with the relevant commercial and bidding teams.



4) Financial and commercial management

Own the portfolio’s P&L, annual business plan, budgets, and forecasts.

Set and deliver targets for revenue, gross margin, contribution, operating profit, and working capital.

Assess landed costs, foreign-exchange exposure, trade spending, promotional returns, and channel profitability.

Lead demand and inventory planning with Supply Chain, Sales, and Finance.

Monitor stock availability, inventory ageing, stock cover, returns, markdowns, and obsolescence.

Recommend allocation of capital and resources based on expected returns and execution capacity.

Review results against approved business cases and take corrective action where required.

Present clear performance reports, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership.



5) Leadership and execution

Build and lead the commercial team as the portfolio grows.

Establish clear responsibilities, decision rights, targets, and performance expectations.

Align Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Operations around shared priorities.

Establish processes for opportunity assessment, partner selection, launches, forecasting, and business reviews.

Set approval controls for pricing, discounts, trading terms, and investment commitments.

Develop team capability in negotiation, account management, commercial analysis, and execution.

Maintain accurate reporting and escalate material risks promptly.

Uphold contractual commitments, brand standards, and ethical business practices.



What we are looking for

At least 12 years of relevant commercial experience, including at least five years in senior leadership within branded products, retail, distribution, or a closely related business.

Demonstrated ownership of a substantial business or portfolio P&L, with measurable growth and profitability outcomes.

A proven record of securing international brand partnerships or negotiating significant distribution, licensing, or franchise agreements.

Direct responsibility for launching brands or entering new markets, including accountability for performance after launch.

Strong understanding of the Philippine retail and distribution landscape, supported by relevant commercial relationships.

Experience managing multiple brands, product categories, or channels with different commercial requirements.

Strong financial judgement across investment appraisal, pricing, margin management, inventory, and working capital.

Experience leading teams, managing budgets, and coordinating cross-functional execution.

Ability to negotiate directly with international principals and present recommendations to executive leadership.

Excellent written and spoken English.

A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline. Relevant postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.



Experience that will distinguish candidates

Commercial responsibility across more than one ASEAN market.

Building a brand portfolio, distribution business, or business unit from an early stage.

Negotiating directly with international brand owners and regional headquarters.

Managing both physical retail and digital channels.

Developing institutional or B2B sales alongside consumer channels.

Turning around underperforming brands, channels, or inventory positions.

Working in an entrepreneurial environment where senior leaders remain directly involved in execution.



Leadership profile: We are looking for someone who makes sound investment decisions, builds strong partnerships, and takes ownership of commercial results. You should be comfortable developing a portfolio strategy and personally leading negotiations, partner meetings, and launches. You will need the judgement to challenge assumptions, the confidence to communicate risks, and the discipline to turn plans into profitable results.



Location, work eligibility, and availability

- Based in the Philippines.

- We welcome applications from Filipino and expatriate candidates who are legally authorized to work in the Philippines.

- Available for regular working-hour overlap with US Pacific Time to collaborate with executive leadership and international partners. The agreed schedule will accommodate Pacific daylight saving changes.

- Willing to travel within the Philippines and across ASEAN, with other international travel as required.



Pay: Php150,000.00 - Php200,000.00 per month

Benefits:

- Commissions

- Flexible schedule

- Promotion to permanent employee

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Quezon City

title: Full-Time Dashboard Developer - Build Our Multi-Store P&L Command Center
description:
Type: Full-time · Remote Salary: $1,000 USD fixed price + month + performance bonuses for extra scope Start: ASAP the core dashboard must be live before Q4 (October at the absolute latest)



The problem we want you to solve



We run a multi-brand e-commerce group with 5 Shopify stores across the UK, US & EU , spending daily on Meta, Google and Pinterest Ads.



Right now our numbers live in different places: Shopify admin, three ad platforms, supplier COGS sheets, refund reports, spreadsheets. Every decision starts with tab-switching and manual checking.



We want one screen. A command center where we open a browser tab and instantly see, per store and blended: revenue, ad spend, COGS, refunds, ROAS, blended ROAS, profit and profit margin for today, the last 7 days, the last 30 days, or any custom date range.



If you have built something like this before, this job is straightforward for you. If you haven't, please don't apply.



What you will build (Phase 1)



Data connections



All 5 Shopify stores connected via API, with a clean architecture so we can add store #6, #7, #8 later without a rebuild

Meta Ads, Google Ads and Pinterest Ads connected for live ad spend per store

COGS pulled in per store either from Shopify or from our supplier system / cost sheets



Metrics

Revenue, ad spend, COGS, refunds, contribution margin

ROAS per platform and blended ROAS

Net profit and profit % per store and across the group

Order count, AOV, refund rate



Views



A multi-store view: everything visible in one consolidated set of charts

A per-store view: drill into any single brand

Clear, readable graphs for yesterday / 7 days / 30 days, plus a custom date picker

Period-over-period comparison so we can see whether we are growing or bleeding



Automation



Daily Slack update with yesterday's key numbers per store

Weekly Slack update with growth vs. the previous week

Must-have requirements

A demonstrable track record building a P&L / profit dashboard. Screenshots, a live demo, a Loom walkthrough or a repo — we want proof, not promises.

Comfortable working with APIs and API keys (Shopify Admin API, Meta Marketing API, Google Ads API, Pinterest API)

Hands-on with Supabase and/or Vercel for building and deploying

You work with Claude Code, Claude or Codex as part of your daily workflow — we build fast here

Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills — a lot of our cost and supplier data still starts life in a spreadsheet

Good written English and reliable daily communication



Bonus points (this is how you earn more)

Bookkeeping / accounting skills. We also need our finance side organized — invoices, costs and P&L all in one clean place. If you can build that system (or run it yourself), tell us. This alone can raise your offer.

You can optimize multiple workflows: sheet automation, accounting flows, backend dashboards. The more of our stack you can own, the more projects we hand you.

Experience with e-commerce / dropshipping data specifically

Growth path



Phase 1 is the P&L command center. After that we want to build:



A supply chain dashboard on top of the same system

A product listing system



This can run as a long-term full-time role or as project-based work — whichever fits you better. We are open to your proposal.



How to apply



Read this carefully, because we filter hard on it.



Start your message with the word READY. Applications that don't will be deleted unread.



Then send us:



Your track record — links, screenshots, a demo or a Loom of a P&L or analytics dashboard you actually built. Show us the real thing.

What you would build for us — the stack you'd use and a rough timeline to get Phase 1 live.

How you'd handle COGS — in 3 sentences: how would you get accurate cost-of-goods into the dashboard when it doesn't live cleanly inside Shopify? (This tells us more than a CV does.)

Your position on the offer — confirm you're open to $1,000 USD/month, or make us a proposal. If you want to build the extra pieces (accounting system, supply chain, listing tool) tell us what that's worth and we'll talk. We pay for people who make us money.



We reply fast to strong applications. Looking forward to seeing what you've built.

This is not a one-week gig. Most VAs we talk to are tired of short-term clients who disappear after a month. We are building the opposite: a stable team, daily communication, and real room to grow.

title: Experienced CS Agent: High-Volume Dropshipping
description:
Hi there! We're looking for a CS agent who treats our support operation like it's their own. We want someone who takes pride in their work, cares about our customers, and enjoys being the person the team can always count on.



If you love clear ownership and want to grow with a business that rewards great work, we'd love to hear from you.



Who we are

We run a 7 figure multi-brand e-commerce business with 8 stores across the EU and US. We move fast, we're growing quickly, and we're building a backend team that works together really well. You'll join a team of 12 and work closely with our Supply Chain Manager, Backend Manager, Dispute Manager and the rest of the CS team.



About the role

This is a CS Agent role with a lot of ownership. You'll be on the frontline of support across all our stores. If you also have management experience, that's a big plus. After 2 strong months there's real room to grow into a bigger role. But first and foremost, we're looking for an excellent agent.



We don't want someone who only follows the SOP and waits for instructions. We want someone who spots a problem before anyone asks and takes care of it.



What matters most to us

Above everything else, we value ownership, proactivity and a strong work ethic. We'd love someone who goes beyond their own queue. That means noticing early signs of refund issues, fulfillment delays, chargebacks or disputes, and helping the team stay ahead of them. If that sounds like you, we'll take very good care of you.



What you'll be working on



Customer service across all stores at high volume, while keeping quality high

Keeping tickets moving and flagging backend issues early

Staying closely connected with supply chain and disputes so nothing slips through

Helping us improve our systems so the whole operation runs a little smoother every week



What we're looking for



At least 3 years of CS experience in dropshipping

The ability to handle 20+ tickets per hour comfortably

Strong hands-on experience with Gorgias

A good understanding of high-scale dropshipping: the volume, the margins and the fast pace

Strong experience with Claude and other AI tools, since they're a core part of how we work

A strong work ethic and an ownership mindset

Excellent written English and clear, quick communication



What we offer



A competitive base salary, because we believe great people deserve great pay

Generous KPI-based bonuses on top, so your performance directly grows your income

Real opportunities to grow inside a scaling business

A supportive, driven team that takes the work seriously and helps each other win



Start date: As soon as possible. We're ready to move quickly!



How to apply

We'd love to see how you think and how you take ownership, so please skip the generic application.



Start your application with the words A PLAYER CS. We'll only review applications that do.

Share 3 stores you've worked for that generated $50,000+/month in revenue. If you haven't worked at that level yet, share the last 3 stores you worked for, with a short description of what you did at each.



We look forward to meeting you!

title: Full-Time Customer Success Caller, American Accent, US Kids Coding Schools (Saturdays Required)
description:
theCoderSchool Metro Atlanta runs four coding, AI and robotics schools for kids ages 5 to 18 in Georgia, USA. Families pay monthly for weekly lessons, and we want every family to feel looked after so their kids keep learning with us for years.



THE JOB

You are the friendly voice our current families hear from. You call parents at the moments that matter, catch problems early, and keep families happy and enrolled. You work from a daily list we prepare for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call new families before and after their child's first lesson, then again at 30, 60 and 90 days

- Call or text the same day a student misses a lesson, and book the make-up class

- Call families when their child's coach changes, and introduce the new coach

- Call within 24 hours when a family asks to cancel, offer the options we give you (a pause, a new day or time, a new coach, a group class), and write down the real reason

- Call families whose plan is ending or whose card payment failed, before their lessons stop

- Walk parents through their child's progress report

- Send parents short updates (a screenshot or video of what their child built) from the coaches' notes, and remind coaches when notes are missing

- Send birthday messages, and notes at 6 months and 1 year

- Ask happy families for referrals and Google reviews

- Call families who left a few months ago to invite them back

- Tell current families about camps and workshops first

- Log every call in our booking system (Pike13) and send a short end-of-day report

- On Saturdays, cover the phones and texts for all 4 schools together with our other front desk teammate



SCHEDULE (US EASTERN TIME)

Monday to Thursday, 10:30 AM to 7:00 PM, and Saturday, 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM (40 hours a week). Fridays and Sundays off. This is a night shift in the Philippines.



PAY

$3.50 to $4 USD an hour, paid weekly through OnlineJobs EasyPay (Payoneer). Raise after 90 days.



MUST HAVE

- Saturday availability, 9 AM to 3 PM Eastern, every week

- A clear, natural American English accent

- 2+ years of phone work with American customers (customer success, account management, retention or support)

- A warm, patient manner with parents, and calm when someone is upset

- Good with booking or CRM software

- A quiet room, a good headset, reliable internet, and backup power and internet

- A verified Payoneer account, or one set up before your first payday



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with schools, tutoring or kids' activities

- Pike13, Mindbody or similar booking software



PRIVACY

You will see children's and families' information. You must keep it private and sign an NDA.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the words "Happy Families". We skip applications without them.

2. Record a 1-minute voice clip (Vocaroo, Loom or Google Drive). Pretend you're calling a parent whose child just had their first coding lesson: say hello, ask how it went, and wrap up the call. Then tell us about your customer service experience. Send the link.

3. Tell us your hourly rate, whether you can work Monday to Thursday 10:30 AM to 7 PM and Saturday 9 AM to 3 PM Eastern, and your backup plan for internet and power.



Finalists do a paid $15 test: a few short recorded practice calls, including a parent who wants to cancel.
