title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Part-time Administrative Assistant



Expert in CRM, Process Optimization & Precise Documentation



Hours: 10–15 hours per week, part-time and fully remote

Pay: €1.25 per hour (approx. €54–€81 per month)

Experience: At least 2 years

Growth: Room to grow over time into a managing role with your own assistants

About the Role



We are looking for an exceptionally precise and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to support our Dutch consultancy team for bathroom and kitchen renovations. This is a part-time role of 10 to 15 hours per week. You will play a key role in keeping our business processes organized and efficient. From managing our CRM and scheduling appointments, to handling client communication and improving internal workflows — your work will directly impact the smooth operation of our projects.



This role requires someone who is not only accurate and reliable, but also enjoys building and improving systems that bring structure and clarity to the team. You will mainly communicate with clients and third parties in Dutch, via
 and WhatsApp, with the help of AI tools. We are a large company in the Netherlands, and our loyalty system rewards your commitment and keeps you motivated to grow with us, with salary raises and bonuses.



If you are highly structured, thrive on accuracy, and love optimizing processes, this is the role for you.



Responsibilities

Manage and update our CRM (HubSpot, moving to Bitrix24): client data, pipelines, documentation and reporting.

Handle
 and WhatsApp communication with clients and third parties — always in clear Dutch.

Schedule and prepare appointments and meetings, making sure all relevant information and documents are ready.

Maintain and organize the shared mailbox and documentation systems, making sure nothing is overlooked.

Prepare and follow up on conversations with clients, contractors and partners.

Develop and improve processes, SOPs and internal systems for better workflow and team collaboration.

Collaborate with colleagues remotely and ensure smooth communication across the team.

Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) for translations, summaries and efficiency improvements where applicable.

Build scalable systems that can later be taught to future assistants, ensuring structured onboarding and consistency.

What We're Looking For

Pietje-precies personality (Dutch for someone who gets every detail exactly right): you take pride in doing things 100% correctly, with no room for sloppy work. Slow but perfect is better than fast and messy.

Process-minded: you naturally think in steps, structure and systems. You don't just follow processes — you improve them.

Detail-obsessed: you enjoy documentation, checklists and keeping things clean and organized.

Structured thinker: you build your own methods and frameworks to stay on top of tasks and bring clarity.

Excellent communicator: strong written English for team communication, and able to write clear, correct Dutch with the help of AI tools for client communication.

Tech-savvy & adaptable: experience with CRM systems (Bitrix24 or HubSpot is a plus), Office/Google Workspace and digital tools. Comfortable learning new software quickly.

AI-friendly: able to use AI tools for translations and workflow support.

Trustworthy & discreet: reliable handling of confidential data and sensitive information.

Team player with leadership potential: willing to support colleagues now, and capable of onboarding and training future assistants later.

Experience & Background

At least 2 years of administrative or virtual assistant experience in an international or remote setting.

Experience with CRM systems (Bitrix24 or HubSpot is a strong plus).

Proven ability to manage communication with multiple stakeholders (clients, partners, contractors).

Experience in process optimization or building documentation systems (SOPs, checklists).

A background in consultancy, construction, real estate or renovation is a bonus, but not required.

Education level is flexible — we value skills, structure and precision over formal degrees.

What We Offer

A part-time, remote position of 10–15 hours per week.

(€54–€81 per month), plus a loyalty system with salary raises and bonuses.

Full support and training in our tools and workflows.

The chance to shape and improve systems that the entire company will use.

Growth opportunities: the possibility to train and lead future assistants.

A long-term role in a stable Dutch company, working closely with an international team.

How to Apply



If you are highly structured, precise, and love creating clarity and efficiency, we want to meet you. Please send us your CV (in English) along with a short motivation letter describing how your personality and skills fit this role. Also let us know your availability: how many hours per week (10–15) and on which days.

title: SEO, Google Ads & Apollo Specialist Using Claude
description:
We are two small North American B2B manufacturers selling to architects, contractors and facility managers. You would split your week between both companies, working alongside a full-time teammate who already knows our SEO work.



This is a hands-on marketing role. 

You will do the real work: apply SEO changes, run Google Ads campaigns and launch Apollo outreach. 

What is different is how: we use Claude to do the heavy, time-consuming parts (audits, analysis, drafts, prospect filtering), so you spend your time on decisions and execution instead of repetitive manual work. You review what Claude produces, correct it, and are accountable for what goes live.



What you will do

- SEO: run daily and weekly audits with Claude (indexing, titles and meta descriptions, broken links, rankings in Search Console and Semrush), then make the fixes yourself in Wix and Shopify: titles, metadata, image alt text, internal links, redirects and page content. You also keep a change log.

- Google Ads: manage our Search campaigns. You use Claude to review search terms, performance and ad copy, then apply the changes yourself: negative keywords, ad text, bids and budgets, new ad groups. You track results and explain them.

- Apollo prospecting: build prospect lists, use Claude to pre-filter them, check the first contacts by hand, then set up and launch the sequences. You follow up on replies and keep Apollo and our CRM data clean.

- Reporting: write a short end-of-day report in your own words, with numbers and links, and keep our Trello board current.



Tools you will use: Claude, Google Search Console, Semrush, Google Ads, Apollo, Wix and Shopify , Google Sheets, Trello. 

You do not need to know them all. Tell us honestly what you know.



What we are looking for

- Real hands-on experience executing in at least two of these: SEO, Google Ads, B2B prospecting.

- Daily practice with Claude and the discipline to verify its output before acting on it.

- Careful, detail-oriented, and honest about what you have and have not done. Saying “I haven’t done this yet” will not disqualify you. Claiming experience you don’t have will.

- Clear written English (C2 minimum)

- Comfortable working as part of a pair, and asking questions.



Schedule and terms

Full-time, 35-40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

Compensation: depending on experience, with reviews based on results, skills demonstrated and commitment to the project. We value long-term relationships and want to grow with the right person.

At least 4 hours of overlap with Eastern Time, and availability for early-morning Eastern Time meetings.



To apply, please answer these questions in your own words (short and specific):

- Tell us about a time Claude gave you a wrong or weak result. What was wrong, and how did you catch it?

- Describe an SEO task you did yourself in Wix or Shopify. What did you change, and how did you check the result?

- What have you personally done in Google Ads ? Which parts have you not done?

- You have 500 prospects exported from Apollo. How would you use Claude to filter them, and what would you verify manually before launching a sequence?

- For each tool, say “never”, “basic” or “used regularly”: Search Console, Semrush, Apollo, Wix, Shopify, Google Ads.

- Send us proof of your own work: a link to a portfolio, a report, or a short screen recording (Loom or similar, 3 minutes max). Show a real task you did yourself in SEO, Google Ads or Apollo, using Claude if you did. We want to see what you changed and what the result was, not a general description. Please add 2 or 3 sentences stating which parts you did personally and which parts the team or the client did. Statements like “I did SEO for a client” without a link or a concrete example will not be considered.

- Can you attend early-morning Eastern Time meetings? What is your ideal schedule, your expected rate in USD, and your earliest start date?



Applications that skip the questions or paste generic or AI-copied answers will not move forward.

title: Customer Service E-commerce (Fluent English, Weekend Availability Required)
description:
Are YOU an experienced customer service representative who can read the emotion behind a two-line
 and respond like a real, warm, thinking human being — not a copy-pasted bot reply? Can you handle a chargeback dispute on a digital product and actually have a shot at winning it, knowing exactly what evidence matters when there's no tracking number or delivery signature to show? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING.

We run multiple international companies in the ecommerce and digital education space, including a growing catalog of craft and DIY digital products, selling primarily to English-speaking customers in the US, UK, EU and Australia. We're looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our support team and take full ownership of the post-purchase customer experience.

We need someone to take responsibility for:

Inbox Ownership: Handling our daily support inbox end-to-end — order access issues, missing downloads, billing questions, refund requests, and general product questions — as the friendly, reliable human voice of the brand.

Retention-First Problem Solving: Before ever processing a refund, identifying and offering the right retention or bonus-bundle offer per our SOP. A refund is always the last resort, not the first move.

Chargeback & Dispute Defense: Responding to chargebacks and payment disputes on digital products with the right evidence (delivery confirmation, access logs, communication history, terms accepted at checkout) — you understand this is a different game than physical-product disputes, and you know a genuinely high win-rate claim doesn't exist in this space.

Template Adaptation, Not Scripting: We provide a complete SOP with
 templates for every common scenario. Your job is to use them as a base and adapt the tone naturally to each customer — never robotic, never obviously AI-generated or copy-pasted.

Escalation Judgment: Knowing exactly when a situation (legal threat, unusual request outside our templates, a case that just doesn't smell right) needs to be flagged to us instead of improvised.

Daily Reporting: Keeping a simple log of ticket volume and any recurring issues you notice, so we can fix problems at the source.

Position Requirements:

At least 2 years of specific customer service experience for digital products — not physical/shipping-based ecommerce. You must know the practical difference between a refund and a chargeback, and have direct experience responding to disputes where a tracking number isn't an option.

Fluent English, 9/10 or above: natural, native-sounding phrasing — not translated-sounding sentences. As part of the application, you'll be asked to record a short 60-second video or voice response to a question you haven't seen in advance. This isn't optional — written answers alone won't be considered.

A real thinking mind, not an AI-generated response: we will read your written answers closely, and generic, overly polished, ChatGPT-flavored replies will be filtered out immediately. We want your judgment, not a prompt's.

Comfortable with our tools: Google Drive (sharing, permissions, troubleshooting access errors), PDF delivery, and a shared support inbox/helpdesk.

Availability & Commitment: This role requires coverage 7 days a week, including Saturday and Sunday — no exceptions, no "9-to-5, Monday-Friday" mentality. Minimum 3 hours/day, structured as short check-ins spread across your day (morning / afternoon / evening, your own local time zone). Please tell us honestly: how many other clients/hours are you currently working, and would you see this growing toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months?

Obsessive Precision & Anti-Mediocrity: correct order numbers, correct links, zero copy-paste mistakes in a customer's name or order details. Mediocrity is not allowed in our team.

What We Offer:

A complete, ready-to-use Customer Service SOP with templates for every common scenario, plus clear escalation guidelines — you'll never be guessing.

A short, paid trial period before any long-term commitment.

Career Growth: real potential to become the lead/only customer service representative across our full catalog as it expands, with performance-based rate increases and a path toward full-time.

Screening Questions (Upwork):

Please write a 3-4 sentence sample reply to this customer message: "Hi, I purchased the ebook bundle two days ago but never received the download
. Can you help?"

Have you handled disputes/chargebacks on digital products before? If so, roughly what percentage have you been able to win, and what evidence/approach did you use? (Be honest — we're checking for real experience, not a number.)

What's your current workload with other clients (hours/week), and do you see yourself moving toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months?

This role requires 7-day-a-week availability, minimum 3 hours/day split into short check-ins across your day — not Mon-Fri only, and not one continuous block. Please confirm you're comfortable with this on an ongoing basis, and share your proposed check-in times in your own time zone.

To Apply: Include the sample reply above directly in your application, along with a brief note on your relevant experience. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a short 60-second video or voice response before moving forward.

title: Amazon Operations & QA Assistant (AI-Native)
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Amazon Operations & QA Assistant to help run inventory operations inside our software, Inventory Hero. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, supply chain and inventory management, and will be comfortable working alongside AI every day. Your responsibilities will include:



Responsibilities:

- Finding and filing Amazon inventory reimbursements

- Creating FBA shipments for our clients

- Following up with suppliers and freight forwarders until shipments arrive

- Double-checking numbers in reports, forecasts and purchase orders

- Checking the work our AI agents do before it reaches a client

- Testing new features and writing clear bug reports

- Following QA issues through until they are fixed



About Inventory Hero:

Inventory Hero is supply chain software for Amazon and TikTok sellers. Our software forecasts demand, plans purchase orders and shipments, and finds money Amazon owes sellers. Much of the work is done by AI agents, and our team makes sure the agents get it right. We are a small, fully remote team built by people who have sold on Amazon for years.



We have established systems and SOPs, but we welcome new ideas for doing things better and faster. Experience with Amazon Seller Central is required. You will use Claude (an AI assistant) every day, so you should be comfortable with AI and curious about how to use it well. We will provide training on our software and processes.



Qualifications:

- Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central (FBA shipments, reports, reimbursement cases)

- Experience with supply chain and inventory management for Amazon brands

- TikTok Shop experience (preferred)

- Daily use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT, and a habit of checking their answers

- Strong attention to detail with numbers

- Clear written and spoken English



Your main KPIs will include:

- Reimbursements recovered for our clients

- Shipments created and delivered on time

- Errors caught before they reach a client

- Downloading reports that can't be automated. 

- Bugs reported clearly and followed through to a fix



This is a part-time position requiring 10-15 hours a week, with flexible hours. You will need to be available up to 2 hours a week during California business hours (9 am to 4 pm Pacific), scheduled ahead of time. Pay is $10 USD per hour. We use Slack and Loom for communication.



How to Apply:

- Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter explaining your Amazon and supply chain experience.

- In your cover letter, tell us about one time an AI tool gave you a wrong answer and how you caught it.

- Look at our website, 
ventoryhero.ai, and offer one suggestion on how to improve it.

- We will pick 5-10 people to do a paid quiz to test your abilities.



We look forward to hearing from you and potentially welcoming you to our team, where your work will directly help Amazon sellers keep products in stock and get back the money they are owed.

title: Content Writer & AI Content Editor – SEO Articles
description:
We need a skilled writer to create blog articles and service pages for our clients, and to edit AI-generated drafts so they read like they were written by a real person.



Read Before Applying

This is not a “run it through a humanizer tool” job. We need a real writer who can rewrite AI drafts by hand: adding personality, local details, real examples, and a natural flow. If your process relies on paraphrasing tools or spinners, this job is not for you.

What You Will Do

Writing original articles

    • Write blog posts, service pages, and location pages 

    • Research topics and write for local business customers 

    • Follow SEO briefs (target keyword, headings, internal links) 

Editing and humanizing AI drafts

    • Rewrite AI-generated articles so they sound natural and human 

    • Remove robotic phrases, filler, repetition, and generic intros/conclusions 

    • Add real-world examples, local references, and practical tips 

    • Vary sentence length and rhythm so the writing flows 

    • Match each client’s brand voice (friendly, professional, expert, etc.) 

    • Fact-check claims, numbers, and advice 

Quality

    • Clear headings, short paragraphs, and easy-to-scan formatting 

    • Correct grammar and spelling (US English) 

    • Write meta titles and meta descriptions 

    • Upload to WordPress or GoHighLevel when needed (a plus, not required) 

What We Are Looking For

    • At least 2 years of professional content writing experience (required) 

    • Native or near-native English writing skills 

    • Experience writing SEO content 

    • A strong ear for what sounds natural vs. what sounds like AI 

    • Ability to write simply for everyday readers, not academics 

    • Reliable with deadlines 

Nice to Have

    • Experience editing AI-generated content 

    • Experience writing for local service businesses 

    • Familiarity with tools like Grammarly 



How to Apply

    1. Start your application with the words “REAL WRITER” so we know you read the full post 

    2. Share 2–3 links or samples of articles you’ve written (SEO or local business content preferred) 

    3. In 3–4 sentences, explain how you would turn a robotic AI draft into a natural, engaging article 

    4. Tell us your rate per article or per 1,000 words, and your weekly capacity 





Applications without the keyword or real writing samples will be skipped.



Thank you

title: Short-Form Video Creator for Meta Andromeda Ads (Reels, Instagram, Facebook) | Music Promotion
description:
ABOUT US

We are a music promotion company that helps independent artists get their music heard. We run curated Spotify playlists and a set of Instagram accounts that connect artists with real listeners. Most new artists find us through our paid ads on Instagram and
, so the quality of our video ads directly affects how fast we grow.

We are looking for a creative, data-minded video creator who can turn a scroll into a click.



THE ROLE

You will create video content for several of our music playlists, each with its own genre and audience:

- Indie Rock

- Hip-Hop

- Neoclassical

- Soul & R&B

- Lo-Fi

- [and more]

Each playlist needs its own visual style and tone. A Lo-Fi ad should not feel like a Hip-Hop ad. You need to be able to switch styles and still keep the content strong.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Create short vertical videos (9:16) for Reels, Stories and Meta feed ads, aimed at people on Instagram and
 to follow our 
 playlists.

- Produce a high volume of genuinely different ad concepts: new hooks, angles, formats, visual styles and messages, not just small edits of the same video

- Write scroll-stopping hooks for the first 1 to 3 seconds, plus short on-screen text and captions

- Use AI tools (video generation, voiceover, editing, captioning, image generation) to produce content quickly without losing quality

- Review ad performance with us (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, cost per click, landing page views) and use the results to plan the next round of creatives

- Keep creatives within Meta's ad policies and music licensing rules, so ads don't get rejected or muted

- Organize and label all creatives so we can track which concepts win



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- A portfolio of short-form videos or ads you made yourself. Paid social ads with results are a big plus.

- A solid understanding of how Meta Andromeda changed advertising: the creative now does most of the targeting, broad audiences are standard, and the algorithm rewards real creative diversity over many near-identical variations

- Hands-on experience with AI content tools (for example CapCut, Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Veo, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, or similar). Tell us which ones you use.

- Strong editing skills: pacing, captions, transitions, sound design, text animation

- Good written English for hooks and on-screen copy aimed at a Western audience of musicians

- Ability to work independently, meet deadlines and deliver in batches

- Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video editing



NICE TO HAVE

- Knowledge of the music industry, Spotify, playlists or independent artist culture

- Experience with Meta Ads Manager and reading ad performance data

- Motion graphics or basic animation skills

- Experience with UGC-style or faceless content formats



WHAT WE OFFER

- Creative freedom to test new ideas, with clear feedback based on real ad data

- Performance-based raises as your creatives prove themselves



HOW WE START: PAID TRIAL

We start with a paid trial on 2 of our playlists: Lo-Fi and Indie Rock. This lets you see how we work and lets us see your work.

- Duration: [e.g. 2 weeks]

- Deliverables: [e.g. 6 to 8 distinct ad creatives per playlist]

- Trial pay: [e.g. PHP X fixed for the full trial]



Lo-Fi calls for a calm, aesthetic, atmospheric style. Indie Rock calls for energy, attitude and raw visuals. We want to see that you can do both well.



We judge the trial on creative quality and on real ad performance. If it's a good match, you'll take over video content for our other playlists (Hip-Hop, Neoclassical, Soul & R&B and more) and move to a long-term role.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

1. Links to 3 to 5 short-form videos you created (ads preferred)

2. The AI tools you use and what you use each one for

3. In 3 to 5 sentences: how has Meta Andromeda changed the way you would build ad creatives for a new campaign?

4. Your expected monthly rate and available hours

5. A rough idea for one ad that would make an independent Lo-Fi or Indie Rock artist want to submit their song to a playlist



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short paid test task. The best candidate then moves on to the paid trial with our Lo-Fi and Indie Rock playlists.

title: Video Editor – Reels, Ads & Brand Storytelling (Freelance)
description:
Freelance Video Editor — Long-Term Opportunity



**About Pigment London**



We're a boutique video production studio based in London, creating content for fitness, wellness, activewear and founder-led brands.



We're looking for a talented remote video editor to collaborate with us on a freelance, project-by-project basis, with the opportunity to grow into a regular role as the business expands.



**What you'll be editing:**

- Instagram Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts

- Paid social video advertisements

- Founder interviews and testimonials

- Fitness, wellness and lifestyle content

- Brand films, cutdowns and ad variations



**Essential skills:**

- Strong proficiency in **Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve**

- Excellent storytelling, pacing and shot selection

- Good music selection and sound design

- Confident colour correction and colour grading in DaVinci Resolve

- Clean captions and basic motion graphics

- Strong visual taste and attention to detail

- Good English communication and reliable turnaround times

- Ability to organise footage, work with proxies and deliver editable project files



**Desirable skills:**

- Adobe After Effects

- Advanced colour grading and colour management

- Experience editing fitness, wellness, fashion or lifestyle content

- Experience producing paid social advertisements

We don't want someone who simply adds trendy transitions and subtitles.



We're looking for an editor who understands why a video works — someone who can find the story in the footage, create engaging openings and make thoughtful creative decisions.



Quality matters more than flashy effects.



**Working arrangement**



This is initially a freelance, project-based position with no guaranteed weekly hours.



We'll provide the footage, creative briefs, brand assets and references.



We're hoping to build a long-term working relationship with the right editor as Pigment grows.



**How to apply**



Please include:



1. Links to your three best video edits, including at least two complete videos.

2. A short explanation of one creative decision you're proud of.

3. Your experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and After Effects.

4. Your experience with colour grading in DaVinci Resolve.

5. Your usual fee for a polished 45-second Reel.

6. Your current availability and typical turnaround time.

We look forward to seeing your work!

title: Administrative & Marketing Assistant (Virtual)
description:
Administrative & Marketing Assistant (Virtual)

CREW Silicon Valley  |

Founded in 1981, we advance women in commercial real estate through business networking, leadership development, career outreach, and industry research. You will support 3 to 5 volunteer board members of this non-profit, educational organization.

Reports to: CREW SV President.

Response time: Reply to requests by the next business day.

Pay: USD $8 per hour (or PHP equivalent), paid via Wise every two weeks.

Start: On or around December 1, 2026, with a 30-day trial period (check-in after week 1 and a review with the chapter President at Day 30), then quarterly reviews.

Success measures: On-time delivery of well written and well-designed newsletters, e-blasts, and posts; accuracy of event, website, and registration details; and regular, clear reporting to the Board.

Work style: Remote, computer-based work. Tasks come in writing from a director of the Board, with a due date.

Responsibilities

1. Inbox: Respond to or route
s sent to chapter’s
, using templates provided by the Board, follow up on outstanding action items; simplify or automate repetitive tasks.

2. Chapter Marketing & Communications:  Under the direction of the Communications Director - Create impactful graphics, using Canva and following the organization’s brand guidelines.  Design and publish marketing newsletters and event announcements in Constant Contact.  Create and schedule social media posts.  Create and update brochures, flyers, and event slide decks.  Design and execute based on marketing calendar, track & report results.

3. Chapter events & programs setup: Enter event, fee, and sponsorship details in CREW Network, set up registration, run test registrations, and submit events with marketing materials. Send weekly registration stats to the Program Director.

Qualifications

1. 5 years’ working experience in marketing and communications, including prior virtual assistant experience, with examples of results you delivered (such as running a newsletter or
 program, managing event registrations, or keeping a website current). US commercial real estate or a related industry is preferred.

2. Strong attention to detail in communications, graphics, timelines, and financial figures.

3. Organized self-starter who takes ownership: follows through reliably on deadlines and recurring tasks, flags problems early, and handles competing requests and unclear instructions by asking good questions promptly.

4. Advanced skill in Canva, Constant Contact, Wix, Google Workspace, and Excel or Google Sheets.

5. Enjoys documenting processes and creating templates and tools that others can use.

6. Dedicated, quiet workspace with reliable internet and a working Windows laptop with Microsoft Office. Two US-based references, each with at least 2 years’ working relationship and within the last 5 years.

How to apply

 your CV, and a one-paragraph summary of results you delivered in a past role (for example, sample newsletters you produced, event registrations managed, or URLs to website you kept current) to 
 initial phone interviews, finalists complete a Kolbe-A or DISC assessment paid for by CREW SV, and Zoom-based interviews with 3 US-based board members.

title: Hiring: Executive Assistant & Founder’s Right Hand
description:
Hi, I'm Dr. Joshi, an American Psychologist living in India, with a very busy life.



I'm looking for a highly organized, proactive, tech-savvy Executive Assistant to become my trusted right hand.



I have a small business that moves fast, with lots of ideas, projects, and moving parts. I need someone who can help me stay organized, build efficient systems, coordinate with my team, and make sure things actually get done.



This is not a traditional admin role. I'm looking for someone who takes ownership, solves problems independently, is empathetic, and and understand my needs, and is very responsive to me. If you can learn new tools quickly, and you enjoy creating order out of chaos, let's talk!



What You'll Do



1. Keep Me Organized



Turn my WhatsApp messages, voice notes, and ideas into organized tasks and projects.



Build and maintain a clear, visual dashboard of everything I'm working on.



Track priorities, deadlines, decisions, and follow-ups.



Create an efficient system for us to work together so nothing falls through the cracks.



2. Build Systems & SOPs



Review existing staff responsibilities and write clear job descriptions for team members.



Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), checklists, and documentation.



Set up a simple, effective system for assigning tasks, tracking progress, and keeping the team's work flowing.



Identify bottlenecks and improve workflows using project management and AI tools.



3. Keep Projects Moving



Coordinate with staff, delegate tasks, and follow up on deadlines.



Proactively identify delays and help resolve problems.



Step in and complete tasks yourself when another team member can't get something done quickly enough.



Keep me updated without requiring me to chase information.



4. Execute Tasks Quickly



Make updates in Kajabi (pages, courses, offers, and automations).



Upload and manage videos in YouTube Studio.



Handle Instagram posting, scheduling, and routine updates.



Complete administrative and technical tasks across different online platforms.



Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to work faster and more efficiently.



Who I'm Looking For



Exceptionally organized, reliable, and detail-oriented.



Highly responsive, proactive, and an excellent communicator.



Experienced in supporting a busy founder or entrepreneur.



Able to create SOPs, document processes, and build practical systems.



Comfortable coordinating team members and managing multiple priorities.



Hands-on Kajabi experience is required.



Tech-savvy and comfortable with project management tools, Google Workspace, YouTube Studio, Instagram, and AI tools.



Independent problem-solver who takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions.



Schedule & Communication



This is a 25-hour-per-week position at $8 USD/hour.



You must be available for dedicated live working sessions with me 1-3 days/week at these times:



Monday: 7:30 PM Philippine Time (2–3 hours)



Tuesday: 7:30 PM Philippine Time (2–3 hours)



Wednesday: 7:30 PM Philippine Time (2–3 hours)



The remaining hours will be used for independent work, team coordination, and execution.



You must be responsive on WhatsApp and acknowledge messages within one hour during agreed working hours.



How to Apply



Please send:



A brief introduction and your relevant experience.



Examples of SOPs, dashboards, or systems you've built.



Examples of your hands-on Kajabi experience.



Confirmation that you can attend the weekly required evening working sessions.



Confirmation that you can respond to my messages within 1 hour during our agreed upon windows of time.



To Apply - Answer this question:



If you joined a fast-moving business where the founder has lots of ideas, tasks are scattered across WhatsApp, and staff responsibilities aren't clearly documented, what would you do in your first 30 days?



Start your application with RIGHT HAND so I know you've read the posting.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical assessment.

title: BOOKKEEPER/ BUSINESS MANAGEMENT STAFF
description:
## POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Business Management / Bookkeeping Staff member to provide day-to-day accounting and administrative support for one of our key clients. This position will work closely with the client and our accounting team to manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, commission reporting, financial records, and other business management responsibilities.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, responsive, able to manage multiple priorities, and comfortable communicating directly with clients, vendors, and employees.



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



### Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable



* Manage and maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Process vendor invoices, payments, and customer receipts.

* Monitor outstanding receivables and follow up on past-due balances.

* Maintain accurate vendor and customer records.

* Assist with cash flow monitoring and payment scheduling.



### Commission Reporting



* Prepare recurring commission reports and calculations.

* Review sales and transaction information for accuracy.

* Coordinate commission payments and resolve discrepancies.

* Maintain supporting documentation for commission calculations.



### Payroll



* Coordinate and process payroll information.

* Review payroll reports for accuracy.

* Maintain employee payroll records and assist with payroll-related questions.

* Coordinate with the payroll provider and accounting team as needed.



### Client Support



* Serve as a primary day-to-day contact for the client regarding accounting and business management matters.

* Respond to client questions and requests in a timely and professional manner.

* Coordinate with vendors, employees, and other third parties on behalf of the client.

* Identify issues and communicate them to the appropriate accounting or management team.



### Bookkeeping & Financial Administration



* Perform bank and credit card reconciliations.

* Maintain accurate and organized accounting records.

* Assist with monthly financial reporting and account analysis.

* Enter and review transactions in QuickBooks Online.

* Assist with budgeting, cash flow tracking, and other financial analysis as needed.



### General Business Management Support



* Handle miscellaneous accounting, business management, and administrative tasks related to the client's business.

* Assist with special projects and financial research.

* Maintain organized electronic records and supporting documentation.

* Coordinate with the tax and accounting teams regarding tax filings, information requests, and year-end matters.

* Take on additional responsibilities as needed to support the client's business operations.



## QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS



* Minimum 2 years of experience working with U.S.-based clients or accounts.

* 2+ years of bookkeeping, accounting, business management, or related experience.

* Strong understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Experience with payroll and commission calculations preferred.

* QuickBooks Online experience preferred.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent attention to detail and organization.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.

* Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive financial and payroll information.

* Strong client service and communication skills.



## IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal candidate is someone who can become familiar with the client's business and serve as a reliable day-to-day financial resource. This person should be proactive, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities.



## WHAT TO EXPECT



As a member of our team, you can expect:



* A welcoming and inclusive environment where your opinions and ideas are valued.

* Opportunities for personal and professional growth through ongoing training and development.

* Competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your family.

* Flexibility to achieve a work-life balance that suits your needs.

* An atmosphere that encourages innovation, creativity, and collaboration.

* Regular team-building activities and social events to unwind and build lasting relationships with your colleagues.



## WORK SCHEDULE



**Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (California time)**



## WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?



* Competitive salary, depending on experience

* 24 PTO credits

* Remote opportunity — work from the comfort of your home

* Long-term opportunity with career growth and advancement



## OUR BACKGROUND



We are a **U.S.-based accounting firm** committed to providing exceptional service and value to our clients. We believe our success starts with a strong, qualified team and a supportive company culture.



We value teamwork, professional growth, and a positive attitude. Our core belief is that **attitude is just as important, if not more important, than technical skills**, and we strive to create an environment where our team members feel valued, supported, and empowered to grow.

title: BOOKKEEPER / BUSINESS MANAGEMENT STAFF
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Business Management / Bookkeeping Staff member to provide day-to-day accounting and administrative support for one of our key clients. This position will work closely with the client and our accounting team to manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, commission reporting, financial records, and other business management responsibilities.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, responsive, able to manage multiple priorities, and comfortable communicating directly with clients, vendors, and employees.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable



* Manage and maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Process vendor invoices, payments, and customer receipts.

* Monitor outstanding receivables and follow up on past-due balances.

* Maintain accurate vendor and customer records.

* Assist with cash flow monitoring and payment scheduling.



Commission Reporting



* Prepare recurring commission reports and calculations.

* Review sales and transaction information for accuracy.

* Coordinate commission payments and resolve discrepancies.

* Maintain supporting documentation for commission calculations.



Payroll



* Coordinate and process payroll information.

* Review payroll reports for accuracy.

* Maintain employee payroll records and assist with payroll-related questions.

* Coordinate with the payroll provider and accounting team as needed.



Client Support



* Serve as a primary day-to-day contact for the client regarding accounting and business management matters.

* Respond to client questions and requests in a timely and professional manner.

* Coordinate with vendors, employees, and other third parties on behalf of the client.

* Identify issues and communicate them to the appropriate accounting or management team.



Bookkeeping & Financial Administration



* Perform bank and credit card reconciliations.

* Maintain accurate and organized accounting records.

* Assist with monthly financial reporting and account analysis.

* Enter and review transactions in QuickBooks Online.

* Assist with budgeting, cash flow tracking, and other financial analysis as needed.



General Business Management Support



* Handle miscellaneous accounting, business management, and administrative tasks related to the client's business.

* Assist with special projects and financial research.

* Maintain organized electronic records and supporting documentation.

* Coordinate with the tax and accounting teams regarding tax filings, information requests, and year-end matters.

* Take on additional responsibilities as needed to support the client's business operations.



QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS



* Minimum 2 years of experience working with U.S.-based clients or accounts.

* 2+ years of bookkeeping, accounting, business management, or related experience.

* Strong understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Experience with payroll and commission calculations preferred.

* QuickBooks Online experience preferred.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent attention to detail and organization.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.

* Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive financial and payroll information.

* Strong client service and communication skills.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal candidate is someone who can become familiar with the client's business and serve as a reliable day-to-day financial resource. This person should be proactive, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities.



WHAT TO EXPECT



As a member of our team, you can expect:



* A welcoming and inclusive environment where your opinions and ideas are valued.

* Opportunities for personal and professional growth through ongoing training and development.

* Competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your family.

* Flexibility to achieve a work-life balance that suits your needs.

* An atmosphere that encourages innovation, creativity, and collaboration.

* Regular team-building activities and social events to unwind and build lasting relationships with your colleagues.



WORK SCHEDULE



**Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (California time)**



WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?



* Competitive salary, depending on experience

* 24 PTO credits

* Remote opportunity — work from the comfort of your home

* Long-term opportunity with career growth and advancement



OUR BACKGROUND



We are a U.S.-based accounting firm committed to providing exceptional service and value to our clients. We believe our success starts with a strong, qualified team and a supportive company culture.



We value teamwork, professional growth, and a positive attitude. Our core belief is that attitude is just as important, if not more important, than technical skills, and we strive to create an environment where our team members feel valued, supported, and empowered to grow.

title: US Tax Specialist
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.

*Analyze financial statements, prior-year returns, accounting records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software. Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Preferred Qualifications

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.



Tech Requirements:

*Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

*Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed



Job Type: Full-time

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–2:00 PM US Central standard time // 8PM to 4AM Philippine Time

Salary Range: Php 160,
,000 monthly, Depending on experience



Full-Time Performance Bonuses:



We believe exceptional professionals deserve competitive compensation, meaningful

opportunities to grow, and a work environment that supports their lives outside the

Office.



*Our full-time team bonuses include:

Generous Paid Time Off: Accrues at 21 paid days annually, increasing to 30 days after three years.

*Extended Weekends: One four-day weekend each month during our off-season, separate from regular PTO.

* Quarterly Profit-Sharing Bonuses: Opportunities to share in the firm’s financial success.

*Health Benefits: Health insurance reimbursement for you and your family.

* In-Home Support: Monthly allowance toward household assistance or childcare.

* Internet Allowance: Monthly reimbursement for reliable home internet.

* 13th-Month Bonus: Additional month’s compensation after one year.

*Work-Life Balance: A consistent 40-hour workweek with no mandatory overtime, including during tax season.

*Professional Growth: Opportunities to deepen your tax strategy expertise, expand your responsibilities, and advance within our growing firm.

title: Part-Time VA – Outbound Calling, Client Follow-Up & GoHighLevel (US Home Inspections)
description:
Up Close Inspections is a property inspection company in Northeast Ohio with over 15 years of experience. We work with US homebuyers, real estate agents, and loan officers.



This is a part-time, long-term independent contractor role, about 20 hours per week. Assigned shifts are scheduled within Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Eastern Time. We will give you your exact schedule at least one week ahead. You are expected to be available only during your assigned shifts — no availability is required outside those shifts, and there is no unpaid standby once you are hired. For reference, that 9:00 AM–6:00 PM ET window is 10:00 PM–7:00 AM Philippine time during US standard time, and 9:00 PM–6:00 AM during US daylight saving time; your assigned shifts are within that window and are not necessarily the full window.



Pay is $5.00 per hour during a paid two-week training period, then $8.00 per hour once you complete training and join the team. All training hours are paid. After you are hired, you will log every paid hour in Clockify, and pay is sent bi-weekly through Wise.



Your main job: follow up with our past clients and call US real estate agents to build referral relationships, while keeping every contact correctly tagged and moving through our GoHighLevel pipelines so nothing is missed. We also use Spectora for inspection scheduling.



**What you’ll do**

- Make outbound calls to US real estate agents and loan officers using our scripts

- Follow up with past and current clients by phone, text, and

- Move contacts and opportunities through GoHighLevel pipelines and log every call with clear notes

- Tag every contact correctly and keep the CRM clean

- Book inspections and offer add-on services (radon, sewer scope, mold, termite, water testing)

- Run agent outreach campaigns, follow up on tasks, and send review requests

- Follow our SOPs and call scripts

- Track paid time in Clockify



**Must have**

- Real phone experience. This is mandatory. We need 1+ year of outbound or inbound calling with US customers (BPO, sales, appointment setting, or similar). Applications without phone experience will not be considered.

- Clear, easy-to-understand, friendly phone English. Careful listening and accurate intake are essential. A native accent is not required.

- 1+ year of hands-on GoHighLevel experience: pipelines, opportunities, tags, smart lists, Conversations, calendars, workflows

- Reliable internet that meets these minimums: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, and ping under 80 ms. You must send a speedtest.net screenshot taken with any VPN turned off. Wired is preferred if you have it.

- A backup power plan and a backup internet plan (for example a second ISP, mobile data, or a backup connection)

- A quiet workspace and a noise-canceling headset

- Reply to messages within 30–60 minutes during your assigned shift



**Nice to have**

- US real estate, mortgage, or insurance experience

- Spectora or other scheduling software



**Why work with us**

- Long-term role with room to grow into full time

- Small, supportive team with clear SOPs, scripts, and training



**How to apply — please follow all instructions**



Applications that do not follow every step will not be reviewed. Applications without the required 1–2 minute English voice recording are automatically declined.



**Subject line:** NORTHEAST90 - [Your Name]



**Apply Points:** Apply using exactly 8 Apply Points. Applications that use a different number will not be reviewed.



Your application must include all of the following:



1. A new 1–2 minute voice recording in English (Vocaroo or a similar link is fine). In your own words, introduce yourself, describe your phone experience, and explain why you would be a good fit. Do not send an old clip. A native accent is not required; we need clear, professional phone English.



2. A short description of your phone experience, including company name, length of employment, about how many calls you handled per day, and whether you spoke with US customers or real estate professionals.



3. A short description of your GoHighLevel experience (pipelines, tags, workflows, and follow-up).



4. Whether you currently have any other jobs or commitments.



5. Confirmation that you can commit to at least 90 days, and that you will give two weeks’ notice if you leave.



6. Your backup plan if your power or internet goes out.



7. Which hours, in Eastern Time, you can work each day.



8. A new speedtest.net screenshot, taken with any VPN turned off (wired, if you can). We need to see download, upload, and ping.



**What happens next (unpaid screening, then paid training)**



Before any paid time, shortlisted applicants complete an unpaid screening:



1. The audio intro (required with your application)

2. A timed written
/text test

3. A mock phone call

4. A GoHighLevel sandbox test

5. An internet and backup-power check



Only applicants who pass all five steps may be offered the paid two-week training at $5.00 per hour, then $8.00 per hour. All paid training and work hours are tracked in Clockify. Passing screening is not a job offer.



We’re looking for someone with real phone experience, clear and friendly English, strong GoHighLevel skills, and a professional phone presence. If you read this far, put NORTHEAST90 in your subject line, use exactly 8 Apply Points, and send the recording and speed test with your application.

title: Sales Representative | Inbound & Outbound Sales | 3+ Years Experience
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Opportunity | U.S. Business Hours



We are looking for an experienced Sales Representative with at least 3 years of professional sales experience.



This is not an entry-level sales position.



We are looking for a confident, results-driven professional who can handle inbound and outbound sales, lead follow-up, appointment setting, objection handling, CRM management, and closing.



The ideal candidate can quickly understand products and services, identify customer needs, build rapport, follow up consistently, and confidently move opportunities toward a sale.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Handle inbound sales calls and inquiries

- Make outbound calls to leads and prospects

- Qualify potential customers

- Identify customer needs

- Explain products, services, pricing, and next steps

- Build rapport and establish trust

- Handle objections professionally

- Ask for the sale or appointment

- Follow up with leads who have not yet made a decision

- Re-engage previous leads and opportunities

- Schedule appointments or consultations

- Follow up on quotes and estimates

- Maintain an organized sales pipeline

- Update lead statuses and notes in the CRM

- Meet sales, conversion, appointment, and activity goals



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You must have:



- 3+ years of professional sales experience

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Strong phone sales experience

- Experience with inbound and/or outbound sales

- Experience handling objections

- Experience following up with leads

- Confidence asking customers to make a purchasing decision

- CRM experience

- Strong listening and communication skills

- Ability to work independently

- Strong organization and follow-through

- Reliable internet and professional remote work setup



Experience working with U.S.-based customers is strongly preferred.



STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience in several of the following is a major advantage:



- Inside Sales

- Inbound Sales

- Outbound Sales

- Appointment Setting

- Lead Generation

- Lead Follow-Up

- B2B Sales

- B2C Sales

- Phone Sales

- Customer Service

- Account Management

- CRM Management



Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Zoho, or similar CRM systems is also valuable.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong candidate if you:



- Are confident and natural on the phone

- Can build rapport quickly

- Know how to ask strong discovery questions

- Listen before pitching

- Can handle objections without sounding scripted

- Are comfortable asking for the sale

- Follow up consistently

- Do not give up after one unanswered call

- Are motivated by targets and measurable results

- Keep your CRM organized

- Are coachable and receptive to feedback

- Take ownership of your pipeline

- Learn new products and services quickly



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF



- You have less than 3 years of sales experience

- Your experience is limited to lead generation without actual sales conversations

- You are uncomfortable handling objections

- You are uncomfortable making outbound calls

- You have never worked toward sales targets or KPIs

- You require constant supervision



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



SALES – [NUMBER] YEARS



Example:



SALES – 5 YEARS



Then answer these 4 questions:



1. How many years of sales experience do you have, and what products or services have you sold?



2. What percentage of your previous experience was inbound versus outbound sales?



3. What CRM systems have you personally used, and what did you manage inside them?



4. A prospect says, “I'm interested, but I need to think about it.” What would you say next?



Please attach your updated resume.



We will prioritize candidates with proven sales experience, excellent English communication, strong objection handling, consistent follow-up, and a demonstrated ability to move opportunities toward a sale.

title: AI Operations & Social Media Manager (Virtual Assistant)
description:
Position: AI Operations & Social Media Manager

Company: EasyTaxesOnline

Location: Remote (Anywhere — U.S. time zone overlap required)

Hours: 35-40 hours/week

Type: Contract / Long-term



ABOUT EASYTAXESONLINE

EasyTaxesOnline is a modern tax preparation and financial services company with 20+ years of expertise. We help individuals and businesses with expert tax preparation, credit optimization, business formation, funding readiness, and financial education. We're based in Las Vegas and serve clients nationwide.

We recently rebranded and are launching an aggressive social media and marketing campaign. We need someone to manage our AI-powered content creation and social media operations so our founder can focus on tax preparation and business strategy.



THE ROLE

You will be the AI Operations Manager and Social Media Manager for EasyTaxesOnline. This is NOT a traditional social media role — you'll be using AI tools extensively to create, manage, and publish content at scale.

You will manage:



AI content generation tools (image, video, copy)

Social media scheduling and publishing

Community engagement (replies, DMs, comments)

Brand quality control

Basic analytics and reporting



You will NOT be responsible for:



Creating all content from scratch manually

Developing overall business strategy

Managing paid advertising (initially)

Customer service or sales





WHAT YOU'LL DO DAILY

Content Creation (using AI tools):



Generate social media graphics, carousels, and images using AI design tools

Create short-form video content using AI video tools

Create and manage AI avatar/clone videos for promotional content

Write captions and copy using AI writing assistants

Edit and refine AI outputs to match brand guidelines

Ensure all content meets our brand standards before publishing



Social Media Management:



Schedule and publish 25-45 posts/day across 5 platforms

Manage Instagram,
, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, and TikTok

Post Stories (10-12/day Instagram, 6-8/day
)

Monitor comments and DMs — respond or escalate as needed

Engage with relevant accounts to grow our presence



Quality Control:



Review all AI-generated content against brand guidelines

Ensure correct colors, fonts, messaging, and tone

Flag anything that needs founder approval

Maintain content calendar and asset organization



Reporting:



Track basic metrics (followers, engagement, reach)

Weekly summary of performance

Note what's working and what's not





WEEKLY VOLUME

This is a high-volume role. Here's what you'll manage:



X/Twitter: 7-10 posts per day (49-70 per week)

Instagram: 2 feed posts + 2-3 Reels + 10-12 Stories per day (98-119 pieces per week)

: 2 feed posts + 6-8 Stories per day (56-70 pieces per week)

LinkedIn: 2 posts per day (14 per week)

TikTok: 5-6 posts per day (35-42 per week)



Total:
+ pieces of content per week



This is achievable with AI tools — but you must be comfortable working with AI and moving quickly.



REQUIREMENTS

Must Have:



2+ years experience managing social media accounts (business, not personal)

Hands-on experience with AI tools for content creation

Strong written English (captions, replies, engagement)

Highly organized and detail-oriented

Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision

Reliable internet and computer setup

Available during U.S. business hours (at least 4-5 hour overlap with Pacific Time)



Experience We're Looking For:



Managing multiple social media platforms simultaneously

Using AI to generate images, graphics, or designs

Using AI to generate or edit written content

Creating AI avatars/clones for video content

Scheduling tools and content calendars

Working with brand guidelines and style guides





APPLICATION QUESTIONS (Required)

Please answer ALL of the following in your application. Applications without answers will not be considered.



1. AI Tools Experience

List ALL the AI tools you have used for work (not just heard of). For each tool, briefly describe what you used it for and how often.

Categories to address:

 AI image/graphic generation tools

 AI video generation tools

 AI avatar/clone creation tools

 AI copywriting/text tools

 AI design tools

 Any other AI tools



Example format:

"[Tool Name] — Used for [purpose], [frequency of use], [how long you've used it]"





2. AI Avatar/Clone Experience

a) Have you created AI avatars or AI clones for video content? If yes, describe:

 What tools did you use?

 What was the process from start to finish?

 How did you train or set up the avatar/clone?

 What types of videos did you create with it?



b) What are the biggest challenges when creating AI avatar videos that look professional and natural?

c) If you haven't created AI clones before, describe any experience you have with AI video tools and your willingness to learn avatar creation.





3. Social Media Management Experience

 a) What social media accounts have you managed? List the platforms, account type (business/personal), and approximate 

 follower count.

 b) What was the highest posting volume you've managed? (posts per day/week)

 c) What scheduling tools have you used? List them and describe your experience level with each.





4. Working Style

 a) Describe your process for managing a high volume of content. How do you stay organized?

 b) How do you handle a situation where AI generates content that doesn't match brand guidelines?

 c) What hours are you available to work? What time zone are you in?





5. Quick Test

Here's a simple brand guideline: "Our brand uses navy blue (#142952) as the primary color, green (#39AC6B) for buttons, and gold (#F0B810) for accents. Our tone is professional and confident — never cheap or gimmicky."

Imagine an AI tool generated a social media post with a bright red background, Comic Sans font, and the caption "CRAZY DEALS!!! Act NOW before it's too late!!!"

 a) What's wrong with this output?

 b) How would you fix it or what would you prompt the AI to regenerate?





6. Availability & Rate

 a) When can you start?

 b) What is your hourly rate in USD?

 c) Are you available for 35-40 hours/week?



WHAT WE PROVIDE



Comprehensive brand guidelines (colors, fonts, voice, imagery rules)

Detailed content calendar and posting schedule

Access to AI tools (we'll provide subscriptions)

Training on our specific brand requirements

Clear communication and feedback

Long-term opportunity as we grow





COMPENSATION



Hourly rate: Competitive, based on experience

Payment: Weekly or bi-weekly via PayPal, Wise, or similar

Long-term: This is an ongoing role, not a one-time project





HOW TO APPLY



Send your application to 
] with subject line: "AI Social Media Manager — [Your Name]"

Include:



Answers to ALL application questions above

Your resume or portfolio link

Links to social media accounts you've managed (if public) or screenshots

Examples of AI-generated content you've created (if available)





Applications that don't answer the questions will be automatically rejected.





HIRING PROCESS



Application review (1-2 days)

Short video interview (15-20 min)

Paid test project (2-3 hours of work)

Final decision



We're looking to hire within 1-2 weeks.



RED FLAGS (What Will Disqualify You)



Listing AI tools you haven't actually used

Vague answers like "I'm familiar with many AI tools"

No specific examples of social media accounts managed

Poor English writing in your application

Not answering all the application questions





GREEN FLAGS (What We Love to See)



Specific examples with metrics

Screenshots or portfolio of work

Experience creating AI avatars/clones with examples

Honest about what you know vs. what you're learning

Clear, organized communication

Proactive problem-solving mindset





We're excited to find the right person to join our team. If you're comfortable with AI tools and thrive in fast-paced, high-volume environments, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Creative Strategist / Ad Scriptwriter – Meta Ads for UK Fragrance & Skincare Brand
description:
ABOUT US

Scentsible is a fast-growing UK direct-to-consumer brand selling fragrance-infused body butters and extrait de parfum. We spend thousands of pounds per day on Meta ads and are scaling fast. Our main customer is UK men aged 40+, plus partners buying gifts.



We already have a team of video editors producing 60+ ads a week (AI video, UGC and static ads). What we need now is the brain behind the ads: someone who finds the angles, writes the scripts and briefs, and uses the data to work out what wins.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Research competitors, ad libraries, customer reviews and comments to find new angles and hooks

- Write 8–10 new ad concepts per week, each with 3–5 hook variations, briefed in Notion for our editors

- Write full UGC-style scripts (talking head, founder-style, comparison, reaction, problem/solution) that sound natural to a British audience

- Create new versions of our winning ads (new hooks, new openings, new characters)

- Brief static image ads as well as video

- Review weekly performance data (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA) and explain why ads won or lost

- Run a weekly creative review and give clear, specific feedback to editors



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 1–2+ years writing or strategising paid social ads for an ecommerce/DTC brand on Meta or TikTok

- Proof: examples of ads you scripted or briefed, and the results they got

- Excellent written English, with an ear for how UK customers actually talk (no American phrasing)

- Comfortable reading Meta Ads Manager data and turning it into decisions

- Solid direct-response basics: hooks, angles, awareness levels, offers

- Bonus: experience with AI-generated video ads, or with skincare/fragrance/grooming brands



HOW WE WORK

- Remote, full time, Monday to Friday, with a few hours' overlap with UK working hours

- Tools: Notion, Slack, 
, Meta Ads Manager

- You'll work directly with the founder and our creative lead



PAY

- Monthly base salary plus a bonus for every ad that becomes a winner

- Long-term role with room to grow as we scale



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the words "BODY BUTTER" so we know you read this post

2. Send 3 ads you scripted or briefed (links or files) and the results they got

3. In 3–4 sentences, give us one hook you'd test for a body butter that makes a man's aftershave last longer, and explain why



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test task.

description:
Brand Partnerships Manager

Position type: Contract / Part-time (flexible) Reports to: Talent / Creator (Owner) Location: Remote

About the Role

We are seeking a organized, personable, and detail-driven Brand Partnerships Manager to negotiate and manage sponsorships and partnerships on my behalf. You will be the primary point of contact between me and prospective brand partners, taking each deal from first outreach through to a fully signed contract. Every two weeks you will receive a list of brands and businesses to pursue, and you will own the process of turning those targets into agreed, signed partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

Outreach and Negotiation

• Review the bi-weekly list of target brands and businesses and begin outreach to each one.

• Negotiate terms for every partnership on the list, including compensation, deliverables, timelines, usage rights, exclusivity, and payment schedules.

• Advocate for my best interests while maintaining positive, professional relationships with brand contacts.

• Know when a deal is not a fit, and flag it to me rather than agreeing to unfavorable terms.

Contracts and Signatures

• Once terms are agreed between me and the brand, prepare or obtain a contract that accurately reflects those terms.

• Send the contract to the brand or business and collect their signature first.

•
 the brand-signed contract to me for my review and signature.

• Confirm that a fully executed copy is delivered to both parties and filed in an organized system.

Communication and Reporting

• Keep me updated at every stage of every negotiation, including replies, counteroffers, concerns, and changes in terms.

• Check in with me before agreeing to any major term or deviation from my stated preferences.

• Provide a summary at the end of each two-week cycle showing the status of every brand on the list (pending, negotiating, agreed, signed, declined).

Partnership Management

• Track deliverables, deadlines, and payment dates for all active partnerships.

• Act as the point of contact for brand questions and follow-ups after signing.

• Maintain a record of all brand contacts, terms, and contracts.

Qualifications

• Proven experience in brand partnerships, sponsorships, talent management, sales, or business development.

• Strong negotiation skills with a track record of closing deals.

• Excellent written communication and professional
 etiquette.

• Familiarity with sponsorship contracts and standard terms (exclusivity, usage rights, payment terms, etc.).

• Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple negotiations at once.

• Reliable, responsive, and comfortable working to a bi-weekly cycle.

• Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.

Nice to Have

• Experience in the creator, influencer, or media space.

• Experience with CRM or project management tools (Notion, Airtable, Trello, etc.).

• Basic knowledge of contract review and e-signature platforms (DocuSign, PandaDoc, etc.).

What Success Looks Like

• Every brand on the bi-weekly list is contacted and moved toward a clear outcome.

• Agreed terms are accurately captured in signed contracts.

• I am never surprised: I receive timely updates throughout every negotiation.

• Contracts reach me already signed by the brand and ready for my signature.

Compensation

Paid weekly

Contract bonus: You will earn a $20 bonus for every contract that is fully signed and confirmed. Each bonus is added to your following weekly paycheck.
