title: Video Editor & Thumbnail Designer (Long-Form Reaction & Social Commentary) —
description:
Our viewers are primarily U.S.-based heterosexual men aged 18–40 (with strong overlap among Black male audiences and culturally conservative/traditional men). They value straight-talking accountability, reciprocity, traditional family leadership, and practical, rule-based frameworks over feel-good dating platitudes. They tune in for relatable "big brother" mentorship that cuts through noise and delivers clear, actionable takeaways.



Role Overview

We are looking for a sharp, creative Long-Form YouTube Video Editor & Thumbnail Designer who understands retention pacing, conversational rhythm, and high-CTR packaging. Your mission is to turn raw face-cam reaction recordings into tight, engaging 12-to-25-minute episodes where every cut serves the host's core argument—eliminating filler, reinforcing key points with well-timed memes and sound effects, and delivering scroll-stopping thumbnails.



Key Responsibilities

Tight Pacing & Filler Removal: Ruthlessly cut all dead air, pauses, false starts, stumbles, "ums," "uhs," and repetitive phrasing so the host sounds crisp, authoritative, and natural without feeling overly chopped or robotic.



Story-Driven & Point-Focused Editing: Identify the central thesis and key lessons in every reaction segment. Structure cuts, punch-in zooms, and visual emphasis to spotlight the main points the host is making rather than leaving in tangential rambling.



Tasteful Memes & Sound Effects (SFX): Drop in well-timed reaction memes, pop-culture cutaways, and subtle sound effects to punctuate punchlines, expose double standards, and drive home key points—enhancing retention without over-editing or burying the host's message.



Thumbnail Design & Packaging: Design high-CTR YouTube thumbnails for each episode (combining expressive host face-cam cutouts, recognizable subject reactions from the clip, and bold 2–4 word curiosity hooks) plus optional A/B test variations.



Seamless Reaction Integration & Audio Polish: Balance the source clip (podcasts, debates, courtroom clips) and the host's face-cam commentary smoothly. Normalize dialogue levels, reduce background noise, and maintain consistent vocal clarity across both studio mic audio and external clips.



On-Screen Framework Graphics: Add clean, minimalist lower thirds, chapter markers, and on-screen callouts (such as our 5-point vetting scorecards and rule-of-thumb takeaways) that reinforce the host's points.



Shorts Timestamp Flagging (Bonus): Flag the top 2–3 high-tension moments per episode for vertical Shorts 
 We Are Looking For

Proven Long-Form YouTube & Thumbnail Experience: Strong portfolio of talking-head, podcast, or reaction commentary edits alongside high-performing YouTube thumbnails (familiarity with creators like Mediocre Tutorials and Reviews, Aba & Preach, Taylor the Fiend, or The Roommates is a major plus).



Editorial & Comedic Timing: You listen actively to what the host is saying—you know which sentences carry the weight of the argument and exactly when a 1.5-second meme cut or sound effect makes a point land harder.



Cultural & Niche Alignment: Solid grasp of modern dating discourse, internet meme culture, structured debates, and the tone of constructive masculine self-improvement (grounded, direct, never cheap outrage-bait).



Technical Proficiency: Fast, reliable workflow in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro, plus Photoshop/Canva/Figma for thumbnails, with strong turnaround discipline (48–72 hours per episode + thumbnail).



How to Apply

Send the following with your application:



2–3 links to long-form talking-head or reaction videos you have edited (highlight examples showing tight pacing, clean dialogue cleanup, and tasteful meme/SFX placement).



3–5 sample YouTube thumbnails you have designed (ideally in the commentary, podcast, or reaction space).



Your per-video rate (covering both the 12–25 minute finished edit from 30–45 minutes of raw footage AND the thumbnail) and typical turnaround time.



A 2-sentence note on what makes a reaction video hold viewer retention past the 5-minute mark.

title: Buyer Relationships
description:
In the recording, briefly introduce yourself, then respond as if a buyer just told you, “I’m interested, but I’m too busy to go see it this week. Just send me the details.” Show us what you’d say next.



Real Estate Buyer Relations Specialist | Joe Homebuyer Utah

Joe Homebuyer Utah is hiring a sales-minded Buyer Relations Specialist to build relationships with real estate investors and get qualified buyers out to see the properties we’re selling.



You’ll spend much of your day on the phone. A typical call might start with finding out what an investor buys, move into why a specific property fits their criteria, and end with a confirmed walkthrough. After the showing, you’ll follow up to get feedback and find out whether they’re ready to make an offer.

What you’ll do

- Call, text, and
 investors about available properties.

- Learn each buyer’s preferred locations, budget, property types, and timeline so you can bring them deals that fit.

- Explain property details clearly, handle initial objections, and ask for a specific walkthrough time.

- Confirm appointments, follow up with buyers who miss showings, and get feedback from buyers who attend.

- Keep buyer profiles and next steps current in our CRM. Bring serious buyers and offers to the dispositions team.

- Stay in touch between deals so buyers know who to call when they’re ready for their next property.

What we’re looking for

- Excellent spoken and written English. You can carry a natural phone conversation with U.S. buyers, ask good follow-up questions, and explain details clearly.

- Confidence making outbound calls and asking directly for the next step.

- Strong relationship-building skills and consistent follow-through. Buyers should feel comfortable telling you what they want and why a deal did or didn’t work for them.

- Strong organization and the ability to manage several buyer conversations at once.

- A reliable internet connection, a quiet workspace, and availability to speak with buyers during agreed hours in the U.S. Mountain Time zone.

Experience in phone sales, appointment setting, real estate, or wholesaling is a plus.

How to apply

Use Buyer Relations Specialist – [Your Name] as your application subject line. Include a short summary of your phone sales or customer-facing experience and a link to a 60–90 second voice recording.

title: Content Specialist: Short-Form Video Editor and Content Creative
description:
Hi! I’m looking for a Content Specialist to help grow my online fitness coaching and personal brand on Instagram.



You’ll turn my plans into scroll-stopping Reels, run daily trial Reels, create top of funnel (TOF) content, get creative with Canva and carousels, and use real data to find out what works. I handle the planning and scripting, and we shape the strategy together. Your job is to bring it to life and help us grow.



ABOUT US

We run a coaching business helping women in the mining and FIFO (fly-in fly-out) industry in Australia transform their bodies and lives. Our content is real, relatable, motivating and direct.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

I want someone who lives and breathes content. You love strategy, you love building something, and you get excited when a video takes off and want to know why. You don’t just wait for instructions. You bring your own ideas, your own take, and you’re not afraid to say “I think we should try this”. You’ll take the time to really understand our audience (women working FIFO and in mining), so your ideas actually land with them. If you want to grow with a brand long-term and see your work make a real impact, this is for you.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Edit talking-head videos and Reels into polished, posting-ready content

Create and upload up to 16 trial Reels a day by turning past content into quick variations (new hooks, text, covers, audio)

Research what’s working in our niche and beyond, then create TOF content to trial

Design carousels and static ads in Canva

Research trends, sounds, formats and competitors

Review analytics weekly: what worked, what flopped, why, and what we test next

Bring content ideas and suggestions based on what’s performing

Prepare captions and posting details

Keep the content calendar and folders organised



WHAT YOU NEED



2+ years of short-form video editing for social media (CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar)

Experience with Instagram trial Reels or content testing

Canva skills for carousels and static posts

An understanding of hooks, pacing and audience retention

Comfort with Instagram analytics, and the ability to explain why something worked or didn’t

A genuine love for content strategy and creative ideas

To be proactive and keep working when you’re waiting on feedback, not sit idle

Clear, reliable communication, including short daily updates on Slack

Bonus: experience in the fitness, health or women’s lifestyle space

title: Phone and Patient Experience Coordinator
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

We are a U.S.-based, cash-pay functional and regenerative medicine practice on Eastern Standard Time (EST). We specialize in hormone replacement therapy, peptides, GLP-1 weight loss, and root-cause longevity care, and we provide premium, concierge-level care.



We are hiring a part-time Phone and Patient Experience Coordinator to be the warm, polished voice of our practice on the phone. This is a phone-only role focused mainly on our established patients. You will answer every inbound call, book appointments, take clear messages, make callbacks, and handle any task that needs a phone call. You will speak with patients, pharmacies, sales reps, and vendors, so you must be professional with all of them. New-patient booking will move to this role over time.



This is not an entry-level VA role. You need a great phone voice, strong judgment, and a medical office background.



Schedule: 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday (about 20 hours per week). You must be available live for the full shift. Hours may expand as our practice grows.



Call expectation: You answer every inbound call live during your shift. Missed calls are tracked in our phone system's call log.



We are a premium practice and are looking only for top-tier candidates. If you are an average VA, this is not the role for you.



Who This Role Is For

You have:

- A medical office background (front desk, patient coordinator, medical assistant, or similar)

- A great phone voice: strong spoken English, clear and warm, with a professional, confident manner

- Clear, neutral English accent (minimal accent)

- Strong judgment: you know what you can handle and what to pass to the office manager

- 2+ years of customer service or patient-facing phone experience

- The ability to speak professionally with patients, pharmacies, and sales reps alike



Experience in a hormone clinic, wellness clinic, or functional medicine practice is a plus.



You are proactive, detail-oriented, and do not wait to be told what to do. You stay calm with frustrated or confused callers and make them feel cared for.



Core Responsibilities

- Answer every inbound call live (patients, pharmacies, sales reps, and vendors) with a warm, professional manner

- Take clear, complete messages

- Return calls and voi
s the same day

- Schedule patients in our EHR system (OptiMantra)

- Book appointments for established patients over the phone, collect the patient's credit card to keep on file, and briefly review our cancellation policy using our script

- Make appointment reminder calls

- Make follow-up calls to patients who missed their appointment

- Handle calls with pharmacies and sales reps

- Make any other calls the practice needs

- When a caller has a question you cannot answer, send it to our office manager through Google Chat, get the answer, and call the patient, pharmacy, or rep back

- Follow the practice's pricing script

- Give every caller a polished first impression of a premium cash-pay practice



You will not give medical advice or make billing or refund decisions.



Requirements

- Medical office background

- A great phone voice and strong spoken and written English

- Clear, neutral English accent (minimal accent)

- Strong judgment and follow-through

- 2+ years of customer service or patient-facing phone experience

- Warm, professional, patient, and empathetic phone manner

- Comfortable handling confidential medical information and patient credit card details securely, and willing to complete HIPAA training

- Able to follow call scripts closely

- Comfortable scheduling patients in an EHR system. OptiMantra experience is a strong plus, and you must be able to learn it quickly

- Reliable internet and a quiet home office for live call answering

- Available 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM ET, Monday to Friday (long-term)



Compensation

$5 to $6/hr, about 20 hours per week. Part-time, long-term position. Hours may expand as the practice grows.



We review every application carefully and move forward only with exceptional candidates. Your audio recording and written answers are how we judge your professionalism and attention to detail.



How to Apply

Please include:

A short audio recording (1-2 minutes) introducing yourself, your clinic experience, and why you'd be a great voice for a premium medical practice. Applications without an audio recording will not be considered. Your phone voice is a core part of this role.

A brief summary of your medical office or clinic experience.

Your experience answering phones, making calls, and scheduling patients in an EHR system in a medical office, including calls with pharmacies or reps, if any. Tell us if you have used OptiMantra.

Your available start date and confirmation that you can work 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday.

The word "Concierge" in the subject line to confirm you read this fully.

title: Blender 3D Character Artist & Animator
description:
OPPORTUNITY — 3D ARTIST, ANIMATOR & INTERACTIVE 3D DEVELOPER



Project: PNTZE — Interactive Education Platform

Location: Remote

Experience Level: Junior to Advanced

Engagement: Flexible — Depending on Skills and Experience



⸻



ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for a creative and technically capable individual with experience or an interest in 3D characters, animation, Blender, game development or interactive 3D applications.



We are developing an innovative education platform that uses animated 3D characters to create more engaging, personalised learning experiences.



Our character production process will be supported by existing technologies such as Avaturn, which can generate realistic 3D characters with pre-existing body rigs, facial animation capabilities, textures and appearance customisation.



This means you will not be expected to create complex human characters or character production systems entirely from scratch.



Instead, we are looking for someone who can work with existing characters, adapt them, improve them, animate them and help prepare them for use within our application.



We are open to candidates from different technical backgrounds, including those who have not previously specialised in human character development.



HOW OUR CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT PROCESS WORKS



Our intended workflow is:



Avaturn Character Generation

↓

Character Export & Refinement

↓

Animation & Facial Expressions

↓

Character Testing & Optimisation

↓

Interactive Application Integration



Much of the foundational character creation, texturing and rigging can be supported by existing technology.



Your role would involve helping us build upon these capabilities rather than independently developing every element of the character production process.



OUR MAIN AREAS OF INTEREST



You do not need experience in every area listed below. We are interested in candidates with practical abilities in one or more of these disciplines.



1. 3D MODELLING & CHARACTER CUSTOMISATION



Experience working with existing 3D models, particularly using Blender or similar software.



Relevant skills could include:



* Editing and modifying existing 3D models.

* Adjusting character appearances and proportions.

* Working with clothing, hairstyles and accessories.

* Applying or modifying materials and textures.

* Improving the visual quality of existing assets.

* Working with downloaded, premade or AI-generated 3D models.

* Preparing 3D assets for games or interactive applications.



You do not need advanced human modelling, sculpting or anatomical reconstruction experience.



Our character generation tools will provide the initial character models for you to work with.



2. CHARACTER ANIMATION & MOVEMENT



We are interested in candidates who enjoy working with animation and bringing 3D models to life.



Relevant experience could include:



* Basic or intermediate 3D animation.

* Working with animation timelines and keyframes.

* Applying existing animations to characters.

* Using Mixamo or other animation libraries.

* Editing and combining existing animations.

* Creating simple gestures and body movements.

* Working with facial expressions and character reactions.

* Improving animation transitions.



Examples of movements we are looking to develop include characters pointing, explaining, nodding, smiling, listening, demonstrating and providing encouragement.



You do not need to be an advanced professional animator. Experience working with existing animations and the ability to learn new techniques would be valuable.



3. WORKING WITH EXISTING CHARACTER RIGS



Our character generation technology can provide characters with existing skeletal rigs and facial animation controls.



We are interested in candidates who can work with, understand or learn how to adapt these systems.



Relevant experience could include:



* Working with Blender armatures and bones.

* Using premade rigged characters.

* Applying animations to existing character rigs.

* Basic weight painting and deformation adjustments.

* Working with facial shape keys or blendshapes.

* Animation retargeting.

* Identifying and correcting character movement issues.



You are not required to have experience building advanced skeletal or facial rigging systems from scratch.



4. GAME DEVELOPMENT & INTERACTIVE 3D



Candidates with experience in game development or interactive 3D environments are particularly encouraged to apply.



Relevant experience could include:



* Unity.

* Unreal Engine.

* Godot.

* Three.js.

* React Three Fiber.

* WebGL.

* Interactive character controls.

* Animation state machines.

* Character movement systems.

* Importing and exporting 3D assets.

* Integrating animated characters into games or applications.



Experience creating interactive experiences using existing characters, assets or animation libraries could transfer directly into our project.



You do not necessarily need to be a traditional 3D artist if you have relevant interactive 3D development experience.



5. SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT & AUTOMATION



We also welcome software developers who are interested in working with 3D character technology.



Relevant experience could include:



* JavaScript or TypeScript.

* React or Next.js.

* Python or Node.js.

* API and SDK integrations.

* Blender Python scripting.

* AI-assisted development.

* Automated asset processing.

* Automated character generation.

* Animation control systems.

* 3D asset validation and optimisation.

* Integrating existing technologies into applications.



We are particularly interested in individuals who can identify ways to simplify, automate and improve existing workflows.



You do not need extensive character modelling experience if your software development capabilities could contribute to working with, controlling or integrating animated 3D characters.



6. UI/UX DESIGN & FIGMA — ADDITIONAL ADVANTAGE



Candidates with additional UI/UX design or application development experience would also be of interest.



This could include:



* Figma and interactive prototyping.

* Mobile or web application design.

* Front-end development.

* Responsive interfaces.

* Integrating interactive characters into application screens.

* Designing character customisation interfaces.

* Improving interactive user experiences.



These skills are advantageous but are not essential for the role.



SOFTWARE & TOOLS



Experience with any of the following would be beneficial:



* Blender

* Avaturn

* Mixamo

* Unity

* Unreal Engine

* Godot

* Autodesk Maya

* Character Creator

* iClone

* Three.js

* React Three Fiber

* Meshy AI

* Tripo

* Figma



You are not expected to know all of these tools.



Previous experience with Avaturn is not required. We are equally interested in candidates who are confident learning unfamiliar software and applying their existing technical skills.



ABOUT PNTZE



PNTZE is an interactive, creator-led education platform designed to make learning more engaging, supportive and personalised.



The platform will use animated 3D characters to guide users through learning activities, demonstrate techniques, respond to progress and provide encouragement.



For example, a makeup educator could be represented by an animated character that demonstrates techniques, explains different processes and supports students throughout their learning experience.



We intend to progressively develop these characters from simple animated personalities into more intelligent and interactive digital characters.



Our objective is to achieve professional visual quality, natural character movements and engaging interactions without unnecessarily recreating technology that already exists.



YOUR POTENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES



Depending on your experience and strengths, your responsibilities could include:



* Generating and exporting characters using existing avatar technologies.

* Importing and working with characters in Blender.

* Customising character appearances.

* Applying existing animations.

* Creating additional gestures and facial expressions.

* Testing animations across different characters.

* Improving character movements and visual quality.

* Preparing characters for mobile and web applications.

* Optimising 3D assets for performance.

* Integrating characters into interactive environments.

* Developing reusable animation libraries.

* Helping automate repetitive character production tasks.

* Exploring new tools that could improve our development process.



You will not necessarily be responsible for all of these activities.



We already have a developer working on the application’s architecture, development and integration. We are looking for someone who can complement the existing team through their own particular strengths.



We are open to adapting the responsibilities of the role around the abilities and experience of the successful candidate.



WHO SHOULD APPLY?



We welcome applications from:



* Junior and intermediate 3D artists.

* Blender generalists.

* 3D animators.

* Game developers.

* Game artists.

* Technical artists.

* 3D visualisation specialists.

* Interactive 3D developers.

* Creative software developers.

* AI-assisted 3D asset creators.

* Front-end developers interested in interactive 3D.

* Individuals with relevant personal, freelance or educational projects.

* Multidisciplinary individuals with transferable technical skills.



Professional studio experience is not essential.



You do not need to have previously created realistic digital humans, developed advanced rigging systems or built an entire character production pipeline.



We are interested in practical ability, creativity, adaptability, problem-solving and a willingness to learn.



If you have experience working with 3D models, animations, game engines, software integrations or similar technologies, we would encourage you to apply.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



To help us understand your experience, please provide:



1. Examples of previous work or personal projects relevant to this opportunity.

2. The software, tools or programming languages you are most comfortable using.

3. A brief explanation of your strongest technical skills.

4. Which areas of this opportunity you believe you could contribute to.

5. Any areas you would be interested in learning or developing further.

6. Your expected hourly rate and weekly availability.



You are not required to demonstrate expertise in every area of this job description.



We are looking for someone who can make effective use of existing technology, solve practical challenges and develop their capabilities alongside our team.



If you believe your skills could contribute to this project, even if your background does not match every requirement, we would be interested in hearing from you.

A business may know it needs a stronger online presence, a better website, or a more effective way to reach customers. Your job is to understand what it is trying to achieve, identify the right combination of services, and turn that conversation into a strong commercial opportunity.



You will work with creative, marketing, and web development specialists to shape proposals for clients across different industries. You will own your pipeline and lead opportunities from the first conversation through negotiation and close.

This role offers direct involvement in growing the client’s business across international markets. It calls for someone who can build trust with decision-makers, spot opportunities beyond the initial brief, and deliver results against sales targets.



Key responsibilities

1) New business development

title: Senior US Tax Accountant

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software.  Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Nice to have:

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

title: Interior Designer / Interior Architect
description:
Title: Interior Designer / Interior Architect 

Type: Full Time

Salary: $1,250/month

Hours: 40

Business name: LDG



JOB OVERVIEW

About LDG



LDG is an Australian interior architecture and design studio working across hospitality, food and beverage, shops, retail, automotive, commercial and branded environments.



We are looking for an experienced Interior Designer / Interior Architect to work with us on a long-term basis.



This is a hands-on design and documentation role for someone who can take a project from early design thinking through SketchUp 3D development, detailed design and Revit documentation.



The role



You will work closely with our Senior Designer and Design Director across hospitality, retail, automotive and commercial projects.



Your work will include:



Space planning

Developing design options from sketches, references and verbal direction

3D design development in SketchUp

Building and refining detailed SketchUp models

Revit Design and Documentation

Preparing coordinated drawing packages

Plans, reflected ceiling plans, elevations, sections and details

Joinery and detailed interior documentation

Materials and finishes selection

Lighting and furniture selection

Preparing client presentation material

Design development

Consultant coordination

Reviewing and incorporating mark-ups

Developing concepts into coordinated, buildable design packages

Reviewing and refining design details as projects progress



You may be given a floor plan, photographs, reference imagery, sketches and a discussion about what we are trying to achieve.



We are looking for someone who can understand that direction, develop the design in SketchUp 3D, and translate the approved design into clear, accurate Revit documentation a bonus. 



What we are looking for



Ideally you will have minimum 5–10+ years of professional interior design or architectural experience and a strong portfolio demonstrating both design capability and technical documentation.



Experience in hospitality, restaurants, hotels, shops, retail, automotive showrooms and commercial interiors will be highly regarded.



You should have:



Strong interior design and spatial planning ability

Strong 3D design capability in SketchUp

Strong Revit documentation skills

Experience producing complete interior documentation packages

Experience preparing plans, elevations, sections and detailed joinery drawings

Good design judgement and a strong eye for proportion, material and detail

Good knowledge of materials, finishes, lighting, furniture and joinery

Experience developing concepts into resolved and buildable interiors

Strong attention to drawing accuracy, dimensions, annotations and detailing

Good problem-solving ability

Confidence working independently once the overall design direction is established

Strong written and spoken English

Confidence discussing and developing ideas through Teams meetings and live screen-sharing



Software



Strong proficiency in both SketchUp and Revit is essential.



You must be highly competent in:



SketchUp — 3D modelling and design development



Experience with the following is also highly regarded:



AutoCAD

Adobe InDesign

Adobe Photoshop

D5 Render



Relevant experience



Previous experience in any of the following will be particularly valuable:



Restaurants and bars

Food and beverage venues

Hospitality interiors

Shops and retail environments

Automotive showrooms and customer environments

Hotels

Branded environments

Commercial interiors

Detailed joinery documentation

Construction documentation

Working with Australian, UK, US or other international design studios



The practicalities



This is a long-term, full-time remote role working directly with LDG.



The role is 40 hours per week, with a salary of US$1,250 per month.



You will work in your own time zone. We need some overlap with Sydney for Teams calls, design reviews and screen-sharing, but we do not expect you to work Australian hours.



You may work from home or from a co-working space. For the right person, we would consider contributing towards a suitable co-working arrangement.



We provide access to Revit, AutoCAD, Sketchup, Adobe and Dropbox through our licences for the projects you work on.



We have worked with offshore team members for many years and value long-term working relationships.



To apply



Please
 the following to 



1. Your portfolio



Best work first. We would rather see a smaller number of strong, relevant projects than everything you have ever worked on.



2. Your resume / CV



Your resume must include your employment history and a list of relevant projects you have personally worked on.



For each project, please include:



Project name

Location

Project type

Completion date / year

Your role on the project

The stages you personally worked on

What you personally designed, modelled or documented

Software used



We are specifically looking to understand what you personally did on each project, not simply the company you worked for or a generic job description.



Your resume must show which projects you documented in Revit.



3. One page



Choose one hospitality, retail or automotive project that you personally took beyond concept. Tell us:



What the project was

One design decision you made yourself and why

One thing you would do differently if you were doing the project again



Please write the word DESIGN at the top of your application.



Please note that we can only consider applications that include a portfolio and a project-based resume.

title: Founding Sales Development Representative
description:
Founding Sales Development Representative, Cybersecurity (Remote, Base + Commission) at Atlas



About Atlas

Atlas (
) is an engineering firm that builds and operates mission-critical software, security and infrastructure. We work across the full stack, from hosting and networking to custom platforms, and take on the hard technical problems that keep businesses online, secure and fast. Our clients range from hosting providers and network-security companies to payment processors and professional sports teams.



Security is our biggest growth push right now. Our team publishes real-time technical security advisories, offers a free external security audit, and a free security and DevOps CLI tool. Now we’re launching Argus: one unified platform for security monitoring, prevention, alerting, health checks, and uptime. We're a small, agile, technical team, and you'll be coming in on the ground floor to help take our flagship security product to market.





With the rise of cybersecurity threats, we are in a pivotal moment of the market. Attacks are faster, cheaper and more automated than ever, and small and mid-size companies are now prime targets. Most of them have no security team and no clear view of what they’re exposing or vulnerable to. Argus is built for exactly that gap, and the companies that need it most are just starting to look.



The role

You own the top of the funnel, and you help us design it. You find the right companies, start real conversations with the people who run their infrastructure, and book them into a call with our founders. That call offers either the free security audit or a free Founding Partner trial of Argus. The founders run the calls and close the deals.



You'll also work with the founders on sales strategy: who we target, how we reach them, and what makes them say yes. The role grows with Atlas and with you, based on your effort and results.



What you'll do

- Build target lists of small and mid-size tech companies, hosting providers, agencies and SaaS teams from public information.

- Research each prospect and write short, specific outreach. No mass blasts, no templates sent to thousands.

- Start conversations on LinkedIn, X and
, and follow up until someone is ready for a call.

- Book qualified meetings for the founders, with clean notes on who the prospect is and what they care about.

- Design and improve the funnel: test messages, channels and segments, measure what converts, and double down on what works.

- Track every lead in our pipeline and report your numbers weekly.

- Bring ideas to the founders on positioning, offers and new ways to generate pipeline.



Compensation

- Base: $800 USD/month, guaranteed, paid monthly as an independent contractor via Wise, Payoneer or Deel.

- Meeting bonus: $25 for every qualified meeting held, paid monthly.

- Trial bonus: $50 for every Founding Partner trial that gets onboarded from your meetings, paid monthly.

- Deal commission: 10% of first-year revenue from customers you helped bring in, paid monthly after the customer pays.

- A qualified meeting is one where the prospect shows up, fits our target profile, and has authority over their infrastructure or security.

- Ramp: your first 30 days are for learning Argus, building your pipeline and setting up the funnel with us.

- Targets: 8 qualified meetings by the end of month 2, then 15 a month from month 3.

- Example month at target: base ($800) + 15 meetings ($375) + 4 trials ($200) = $1,375, before deal commission.



Hours and setup

- Fully remote, Monday to Friday.

- Full-time, about 40 hours a week, with at least 4 hours a day overlapping 8am–4pm US Central.

- A reliable computer, stable internet and backup power.



Where this can go

If you consistently put in the work and produce results, this role can grow into:

- Running full sales cycles and closing deals yourself

- Owning a segment, such as hosting providers, agencies, or mid-market

- Building and leading the sales team as we hire

- Higher base pay and commission as the company grows



None of this is automatic, and none of it is capped. We'll review your role, scope, and pay together at 90 days and regularly after that, based on what you've delivered.



Who you are

- 2+ years in SDR, BDR, lead generation or appointment setting, ideally selling B2B software, IT, hosting or security services to US, UK or Australian clients.

- You've helped build or improve an outbound process, not just worked one: sequences, targeting, testing, reporting.

- Comfortable talking with technical people (developers, sysadmins, CTOs) without pretending to be one. You're curious and learn the product.

- You write short, natural messages that sound like a person, not a sales bot.

- Organized and self-driven. You'll mostly work on your own, tracking your own pipeline and hitting your own numbers.

- You want to get in early and build something, not just fill a quota.

- Fluent written and spoken English.

- Bonus: experience in cybersecurity, DevOps or hosting, or a network in that space.



How to apply

 
 with the subject line "Argus SDR - [your country]" and include:

1. Your name, city, and country.

2. A few sentences on why this role fits you.

3. One example message you'd send to the CTO of a small hosting company to get them interested in the free Atlas security audit or Argus product (under 120 words).

4. Numbers from a past role, such as meetings booked per month or reply rates.

5. Your resume. 



Applications without the subject line or the sample message won't be reviewed. We will never ask you to pay anything to apply or to start.

title: Multifamily Underwriting & Financial Modeling Tutor
description:
I'm a commercial real estate professional specializing in multifamily investment sales. I'm seeking a part-time private tutor to teach me multifamily underwriting and financial modeling the way it's taught in a university-level real estate development program — structured, rigorous, and built around a proper textbook curriculum.



This is a teaching engagement, not a one-off training session. I want someone who can guide me from fundamentals through a complete, self-built multifamily underwriting and waterfall model, with assessments along the way to prove I've actually learned the material.



At a glance:

• Role: Private tutor / instructor 

• Schedule: Twice per week (two 60–90 minute remote sessions)

• Format: Fully remote via Zoom/Teams with screen sharing and Excel work-alongs

• Rate: $9/hour USD (paid via Wise)

• Start date: Immediate, upon successful interview



What You'll Be Teaching:

A structured curriculum of your own proposal, modeled on a university real estate development / real estate finance program, working out of a recognized textbook (e.g., Peter Linneman's Real Estate Finance and Investments or comparable). You will propose the syllabus and textbook in your application.



Core topic areas:

1. Foundations — time value of money, NPV/IRR/MIRR, cap rates, NOI, basis points, leverage concepts

2. Multifamily underwriting — rent rolls, market rents, vacancy and loss to lease, operating expenses and expense ratios, capital expenditures, debt terms (amortization, DSCR, loan sizing), investor pro forma conventions

3. Financial modeling in Excel — building a complete multifamily acquisition model from scratch, with sensitivity tables, scenario analysis, and clean formatting standards

4. Waterfalls and syndication math — preferred returns, return of capital, catch-up tranches, promote/carried interest, IRR-hurdle-based distribution waterfalls for LP/GP structures

5. Development topics — land/entitlement basics, ground-up feasibility analysis, construction budgeting and draws, permanent loan takeout, developer profit and developer waterfalls



Curriculum Structure Requirements:

• University-style curriculum: You will map out a semester-style syllabus with weekly topics tied to assigned textbook readings before we begin.

• Work out of a textbook: Each session should build on assigned reading and problem sets.

• Quizzes: Short quizzes at regular mile markers (roughly every 3–4 weeks) covering prior material.

• Tests/exams: Longer assessments at major milestones (mid-program and capstone), including a hands-on modeling exam where I build or repair a model under time constraint.

• Capstone project: A complete multifamily acquisition model built by me from scratch, including an equity waterfall tab, reviewed and graded by you.



Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience underwriting or acquiring multifamily assets (e.g., work at an acquisitions shop, appraisal firm, brokerage, developer, or lending institution)

• Advanced, demonstrable Excel modeling skills (clean formula design, scenario toggles, waterfall logic — no copy-paste templates)

• Practical familiarity with distribution waterfall math and GP/LP structures

• Prior tutoring, teaching, or training experience required

• Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and dual-screen setup for screen-share lessons

• Ability to commit to a fixed twice-weekly schedule for at least 3–6 months



Nice to Have:

• Familiarity with US markets and conventions (Argus, CoStar, or similar exposure is a plus but not required — this course is Excel-native)

• Experience building development / construction-draw models

• Textbook-honed problem-solving: you should be comfortable assigning and grading exercises from a real estate finance text



To Apply:

Please send

1. A resume

2. A brief summary of your multifamily underwriting/modeling experience (deals, roles, tools)

3. A proposed curriculum outline: the textbook you'd use, a week-by-week topic list

4. A sample of your modeling work (screenshots welcome; formulas visible)

5. Your availability (EST) and confirmation you can commit to two sessions per week

- 25-minute 1:1 video calls

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Clear, natural, north american - sounding English (this matters most)

There is no guaranteed minimum at launch, and hours should grow as the program grows. title: Senior SEO Specialist / SEO Manager
description:
We're hiring someone who knows how to think, not someone who just knows how to follow an SEO checklist.



Marketix Digital is a Sydney-based SEO agency working with B2B, industrial, manufacturing and commercial businesses across Australia.



We're looking for an experienced SEO professional who can independently diagnose problems, identify opportunities, prioritise work and take ownership of client results.



This is not a role for someone who simply follows standard SEO practices, generates recommendations from audit tools or produces lengthy strategy documents without understanding what actually matters.



We care about your judgement, reasoning and ability to execute.



What we're looking for



Someone who can:



Look at a website that isn't ranking and independently determine what's actually holding it back.



Distinguish between genuine SEO problems and issues that tools flag but have little commercial or ranking impact.



Understand search intent, competition, technical SEO, content, internal linking and authority, and how these factors interact.



Prioritise work based on likely impact rather than following a generic 30/60/90-day SEO template.



Understand the commercial value of keywords and focus efforts on generating qualified leads and revenue, not just traffic.



Challenge assumptions, including ours, when the evidence supports a different conclusion.



Execute the work themselves, including technical improvements, content development, on-page optimisation and reporting.



Take full ownership of assigned client accounts without requiring constant direction.



What we don't want



We're not looking for someone who:



Recommends improving page speed on every website without establishing whether speed is actually a meaningful constraint.



Suggests directory submissions, schema markup or more backlinks as default solutions without investigating the existing situation.



Produces AI-generated SEO strategies without critically evaluating the recommendations.



Spreads a few days of work across an entire month to make an activity plan look substantial.



Confuses completing SEO tasks with delivering SEO results.



Needs to be told what to investigate, what to prioritise and what to do next.



Tools like Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console and AI are useful. But tools don't replace judgement.



Your responsibilities



You'll be responsible for managing SEO campaigns from diagnosis through to execution.



This includes:



Conducting technical, content and competitor analysis.



Developing commercially focused SEO strategies.



Identifying and resolving ranking and indexing problems.



Conducting keyword research and search intent analysis.



Creating and improving content, landing pages and website architecture.



Implementing on-page and technical SEO improvements.



Analysing rankings, organic traffic, leads and conversions.



Producing meaningful client reports that explain results, challenges and next steps.



Proactively identifying opportunities rather than waiting for instructions.



You'll work directly with the Managing Director, who has over 20 years of SEO experience. You should be comfortable having your recommendations questioned and defending them with evidence.



Experience required



At least 4–5 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in an agency environment.



Strong technical SEO and analytical capabilities.



Experience working with WordPress.



Demonstrated ability to independently manage SEO campaigns.



Strong written and spoken English.



Experience with B2B, lead generation or industrial websites is advantageous.



We're more interested in demonstrated capability than job titles or certificates.



How to apply



Please don't send a generic cover letter or a lengthy AI-generated response.



Instead, answer the following question:



A client has been investing in SEO for some time. Their website ranks reasonably well for several keywords, but they're struggling to reach the top positions for their most commercially valuable search terms.



How would you investigate what's preventing further improvement, and how would you d
 what to prioritise?



We're not asking for a checklist of everything you know about SEO.



We want to understand:



How you approach an unfamiliar problem.



What evidence you look for before forming conclusions.



How you distinguish important issues from distractions.



How you d
 which actions deserve priority.



How you determine whether your recommendations are working.



Keep your response concise. Explain your thinking rather than listing tactics.



Applications demonstrating independent reasoning and practical judgement will be prioritised.



About the role



Full-time, long-term position



Remote, Philippines-based



Working with an established Australian SEO agency



Competitive salary based on experience and demonstrated capability



Opportunity to take meaningful ownership of client campaigns



If you're the kind of SEO professional who questions why something isn't working rather than automatically applying another set of best practices, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (B2B Social Media & Commercial Content)

Location: Remote

About the Role

We are a commercial visual media and social media content agency serving hospitality brands, event venues, restaurants, hotels, and local businesses. We produce high-impact, visually driven content designed to stop the scroll and drive real-world bookings and foot traffic.



We are looking for a skilled Short-Form Video Editor who understands modern pacing, sound design, and commercial aesthetics. You will take raw, professionally shot footage (gimbal, slider, studio lighting, and multi-cam setups) and turn it into polished, high-retention Instagram Reels, TikToks, and promotional edits ready to post.



What You’ll Do

Edit Short-Form Vertical Content: Cut 15–60 second Reels and TikToks tailored for hospitality, food & beverage, venue tours, and brand spotlights.



Nail the Hook & Pacing: Structure edits with strong 3-second visual hooks, tight rhythmic cuts, and smooth transitions that match current social media standards without looking overly "template-y."



Sound Design & Audio Mixing: Source trending or licensed audio, balance dialogue/voiceovers, and layer subtle SFX (risers, whooshes, ambient textures) to elevate the feel of the footage.



Color & Polish: Apply clean, consistent color grading (matching Log/Rec.709 profiles) and add tasteful, readable kinetic captions or light motion graphics when needed.



Manage Fast Turnarounds: Deliver final, ready-to-post exports within 48–72 hours and handle quick revision rounds cleanly.



What We’re Looking For

Software Proficiency: Expert-level fluency in Adobe Premiere Pro (required) and working knowledge of Adobe After Effects for clean titles, speed ramps, and light motion graphics.



Commercial Taste: An eye for luxury, hospitality, and lifestyle aesthetics. You know the difference between a high-end venue promo and a loud gaming montage.



Solid Editing Rig & Fast Internet: A computer capable of smoothly editing 4K 10-bit footage and a reliable, high-speed internet connection for downloading raw shoot folders and uploading final masters via 
, Google Drive, or Dropbox.



Reliability & Communication: Responsive, deadline-driven, and able to take creative direction without needing constant hand-holding.



Bonus Points

Experience editing food & beverage, real estate, hotel, or event/wedding highlight content.



Familiarity with Meta ad creative structures (direct-response hooks, B-roll overlays, and clear visual CTAs).



How to Apply

To be considered, please send your application to 
 with the subject line "Commercial Video Editor – [Your Name]" and include:



Your 3 best vertical edits (Reels/TikToks) — direct links only (no massive unorganized Google Drive folders).



Your editing software and typical turnaround time for a batch of 5 short-form videos.



Confirmation that the $25–$35 per Reel rate works for you, plus your weekly availability.



Quick tech check: Your basic PC/Mac specs (CPU, GPU, RAM) and a screenshot of your current internet speed from Speedtest.net.

title: Virtual Assistant Talent Pool Waves 2, 3 and 4
description:
Video applications only. No CV needed. Medyo mahaba-haba ’to, so brace yourselves. 😄



Hi! We’re opening applications for Waves 2, 3, and 4 of our virtual assistant talent pool at our Florida-based agency. Whether you’ve been a VA for years or you’re just getting curious about VA life, we’d love to meet you and hear what kind of work you enjoy.



We review applications in waves and invite shortlisted applicants to a live screening. From there, we make client introductions when there’s an available assignment that fits your skills, schedule, and preferences.



Two ways to work with us:

- Direct placement. We introduce you to a client and help with the handoff. If you both d
 to move forward, you and the client agree on the work, schedule, and pay before you start. Before we hand you off, the client is your point of contact for day-to-day questions, schedule changes, and payments.  

- Agency-managed. You support a client through our agency. We handle your payments, and you’ll have an account manager for check-ins, coaching, and support. If a client stops responding, treats you poorly, or the assignment feels like a poor fit, you can reach out to us. We’ll help you work through it and support you through the transition if the assignment needs to end.



What to share in your video:

Speak in your own words without reading from a script or notes. Imagine we’re already on a call getting to know each other.  



1. Tell us a little about yourself. What does a typical day look like for you? What kind of work do you enjoy, and what are you looking for right now?



2. Share your availability. Which shift can you comfortably commit to each week, 9 AM–1 PM ET (part-time) or 9 AM–5 PM ET (full-time)? When could you start? If you have commitments during your preferred shift, let us know which days and times. You’re welcome to work with other clients as long as the hours you commit to this assignment are set aside for it. Pick a schedule that leaves you enough time to rest, too.



3. Tell us about your workspace and backup plans. What equipment and internet connection do you use? If your Wi-Fi d
 to take the day off, the power goes out, or your computer stops working mid-shift, what’s your plan? Tell us what backups you already have, how quickly you could get back to work, and how you’d let the client or our team know. If you’re still setting something up, just tell us where you’re at with it.



4. Tell us what kind of work and clients suit you. If you’ve worked as a VA before, share one or two types of clients you feel most confident supporting and up to two types of clients or working arrangements you’d rather pass on next time. You’re welcome to tell us why, and you can keep client names private. Then tell us about one of your longest client engagements, how long you worked with them, and one task you handled yourself. Walk us through it from start to finish. Pick something you know well enough to do on your own, even without AI.



New to VA work? You’re welcome to apply! 

What sparked your interest? Maybe a friend told you about it, you saw it on TV, or you were ready for a change from your usual 9-to-5. Tell us what work you’d like to try and share one task you handled at a previous job, at school, while volunteering, or on a personal project. You can also answer this scenario. A customer asks if their appointment is still on for tomorrow, but you can’t find their name on the calendar. What would you check first, and what would you tell them while you look into it?



5. Tell us which setup you prefer. Direct placement, agency-managed, or open to both? If you’re still figuring it out, that’s okay. Tell us what you’re curious about, and we’ll be happy to talk it through with you.



6. Share your thoughts on brief video check-ins. For agency-managed assignments, your account manager or a team member may occasionally hop on a quick live video call during your shift to confirm you’re personally handling the work and see how things are going. It’s also a chance to ask for help if you’re stuck. How do you feel about that, and what kind of support helps you do your best work?



7. Tell us your expected hourly rate in USD.



8. One last question, just for fun. What’s a plot twist in your life you never saw coming? It can be funny, wild, fun fact.. or as simple as 

“I used to champion in singing contest since grade school hanggang ngayon na may mga apo narin...” 

or "I have Bachelor's degree and all pero pucha, hindi pala sapat, kaylangang humarbat para sa kinabukasan walang katapusan".. 

or "I used to worked sa wet market ng tatay ko... okay naman pero I want to give the best life for them too"

or "I'm a balot vendor, but as you can see, I know I can speak confidently and all and I'm positive I have the chance to work as VA.. sakit na sa lalamunan kaka sigaw ng balot sa gabi mem/serrr" 

... Kahit ano go!  Just share whatever you’re comfortable with.  



Screening and submission:

If you’re shortlisted for either setup, you’ll hear from (Jhon, our VA Scout, or Chi, our agency owner), to schedule a live screening before we introduce you to a client. Please have a valid government-issued ID ready to show privately during the call. Keep your ID out of your application video.



Please apply as an independent freelancer. We accept individual applicants only, and you’ll need to personally handle any work you accept.



Send your video application to:  

 subject: VA Talent Pool Wave 2 3 4| Name | City



If you send a video link, please check that we can open it without requesting access.



Thanks for taking the time to introduce yourself. We’d love to hear from you!



Maraming salamat,

Jhon & Chi B.

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
Trident Digital | Social Media Strategist | Content Strategist

Full-time | Remote Setup/Work from Home

Working Hours: 9AM - 6PM (SGT)

Salary: SGD 1,000/month



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their industry. They don't hire us to post consistently or chase trends. They hire us to become the most trusted name in their market, so that clients and recruits come to them instead of the other way round.

This role owns that. You'll d
 what each client should be known for, turn that into a content direction, and make sure every video and post that goes out actually builds it. You'll run strategy and insights calls with clients, direct our creative team, and read the numbers to d
 what comes next. If you've ever looked at an advisor's Instagram and thought "I know exactly what's wrong with this," keep reading.



What the setup looks like

You'll work with our operations manager, accounts manager and creative team (videographers, editors and designers), with direct access to the founder. Main platforms are Instagram and
, with TikTok and YouTube as secondary. Market is Singapore. Niches are financial advisory and real estate. Every client's content serves one of two goals: winning clients or recruiting agents. You need to know which one you're writing for, every time.



What you'll do

- Define each client's positioning: what they stand for, who they're for, and why anyone should listen to them over the next advisor

- Build monthly content direction and campaigns that ladder up to the client's sales or recruitment goal

- Run brainstorming and insights calls with clients, pull out the stories and opinions only they have, and turn them into content angles

- Present strategy and content ideas to clients and get alignment without watering the ideas down

- Brief and direct scriptwriters, editors and designers, and review output before it goes out. If it's generic, it doesn't ship

- Review performance monthly, identify what's building authority and what's just filling the feed, and adjust

- Build our playbook as you go, so every winning format and angle compounds across clients



How you'll be measured

- Brand growth for your clients: reach and follower growth within the right audience, not vanity numbers

- Inbound signals: DMs, enquiries, and recruitment interest that clients trace back to content

- Client retention and renewals on the accounts you own

- First-pass approval: how often your direction and ideas land with clients without rounds of rework

- You'll see these numbers every month. Good strategists want to be measured. It's how you prove your thinking works.



You'll do well here if you

- Care about the difference between content that gets views and content that builds trust, and chase the second

- Can walk into a client call, disagree with a top producer respectfully, and back it up with reasoning

- Study why a creator's content works, not just that it works

- Give sharp, specific feedback to creatives instead of "make it pop"

- Take feedback well. Your strategies get challenged and reworked. That's how everyone here improves, including us



This is not for you if you

- Want a job where you clock in, clear tasks and clock out at 6 sharp

- Have freelance clients or side hustles competing for your focus. We're not saying no life outside work. We're saying this has to be your main thing, because split attention shows in the work

- Think strategy means a content calendar full of "tips Tuesday" and trending audio

- Prefer taking client instructions as given rather than pushing for what will actually work

No hard feelings either way. We'd rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

- You've run content strategy for personal brands or service professionals

- Bigger bonus: financial advisors or real estate specifically

- Biggest bonus: you've done it for the Singapore market



What you get

- Real ownership of client accounts. Your strategy d
 what gets made

- Direct access to the founder. You learn how the whole business is built, from authority to inbound

- A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, and overseas team trips

- Real room to grow into a senior strategy or account lead role as we scale



How to apply

 
 with the subject line: Your Next Strategist - [Your Full Name]

Your
 should include:

1. Cover letter: years of strategy experience and how you think you can contribute to Trident Digital

2. Updated CV/Resume

3. Expected salary in SGD only

Important Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered.

This won’t suit someone who simply waits for instructions or copies information from one place to another. We’re looking for someone who thinks ahead, asks good questions, reconciles the detail and speaks up when something doesn’t add up.

You’ll have the autonomy to take work from start to finish, with clear access to the Principal when a decision or escalation is needed.



What you’ll take ownership of

• Triage multiple inboxes, identify priorities and maintain visibility of outstanding actions.

• Draft correspondence, coordinate meetings and proactively follow up agents, vendors, lawyers, consultants and partners.

• Review property documents, reconcile leases, income, costs, rates, titles and reports, and prepare clear due diligence findings.

• Build and update feasibility models, documenting assumptions and comparing different scenarios.

• Research planning controls, approval pathways, comparable sales and prospective sites.

• Coordinate consultant briefs and fee proposals, compare scope and pricing, and check invoices against agreed quotes.

• Keep deal information, files and data rooms organised and support the preparation of partner and investor materials.

• Provide concise morning priorities, deal updates and weekly pipeline reporting.

• Document repeatable processes and use AI intelligently to improve summaries, document checks, drafts, trackers and templates.



What we’re looking for

You’ll be someone who can be given an outcome rather than a detailed set of instructions and work out how to get there.



Ideally, you’ll bring:

• Strong numeracy and confidence reconciling documents, schedules, invoices, quotes and financial information.

• Intermediate to advanced Excel or Google Sheets capability, including formulas and financial calculations.

• Clear written English and confidence dealing with external stakeholders over the phone.

• Exceptional attention to detail and an ability to keep multiple workstreams moving.

• A naturally questioning mindset. If something doesn’t make sense, you investigate rather than simply passing it on.

• Confidence using AI tools such as Claude, combined with the judgement to verify outputs carefully.

• The ability to work independently, prioritise competing demands and follow work through to completion.

• Experience within property, finance, accounting, legal support, conveyancing, valuation or project coordination would be advantageous.

Property knowledge can be developed. Strong numeracy, attention to detail, initiative and the willingness to think critically are much harder to teach.



Why this contract is different

This is an opportunity to become a trusted extension of the Principal rather than simply providing administrative support.

As you learn the portfolio and how deals are assessed, the intention is for you to take ownership of more of the recurring work. Automation and AI should progressively remove lower-value repetition, allowing your contribution to move further into feasibility modelling, property research, site analysis and deal preparation.



You’ll have:

• Direct exposure to active property acquisitions and development opportunities.

• Genuine autonomy over your work and how you organise it.

• Direct access to the Principal and the context behind the decisions being made.

• The opportunity to improve systems rather than inherit inefficient processes.

• Scope to introduce practical AI and automation into day-to-day workflows.

• A contract that has room to broaden as trust, capability and knowledge of the portfolio develop.

• The flexibility of remote work with clearly agreed deliverables and working-hour overlap.



What success looks like

Within the first three to six months, you’ll have developed a strong understanding of the portfolio and be independently managing core recurring workflows.

Due diligence and feasibility drafts will be ready for review without repeated prompting, outstanding actions will be actively followed up, and the Principal will have clear visibility across each deal.

Ultimately, success is simple: less time is spent chasing information and managing administration, and more time can be spent making decisions and progressing deals.



Working arrangement

This is a remote contractor opportunity requiring reliable overlap with Sydney business hours so you can communicate directly with Australian agents, consultants and other stakeholders.



The contractor will need to be consistently reachable during agreed core hours, while retaining the independence expected of a contractor in managing their workflow and deliverables.
