title: Part-time Cold Caller / Appointment Setter for US Web Design Company
description:
About us

Jobsite Web Co. builds websites for trade businesses in San Diego County: electricians, plumbers, HVAC, roofers, landscapers and more. The owner, Corey, is a working electrician himself. We're small and growing.



The job

You call small contractor businesses from a list we give you. Every name comes with a short, true reason to call (for example, they just got their contractor license and don't show up on Google yet). Your goal is to book a short meeting or call between the business owner and Corey. You do not sell, quote special prices or close deals. Corey does that.



Hours and pay

- 20 hours a week: Monday to Friday, one fixed 4-hour block during US Pacific business hours (Philippines night shift).

- $5 USD per hour.

- Bonus: $100 USD every time a business you booked pays its deposit to start a website.

- Paid weekly by Wise, every Friday, for hours already worked. No pay in advance.

- Starts with a 2-week paid trial.



You'll be a great fit if you

- Have 6+ months of cold calling experience with US businesses or homeowners (real estate, solar, insurance, B2B all count)

- Speak clear, natural English and sound relaxed, not scripted

- Show up for every shift on time, and tell us at least 24 hours ahead if you can't

- Stay friendly when people say no

- Keep accurate notes, including spelling every
 address correctly

- Have a quiet place to work, a headset, reliable internet and a backup if it goes down



What we provide

- The call list and script

- Your own login to our US business phone line

- A shared sheet to log every call

- Feedback from Corey after your first shifts



How to apply

1. Tell us about your cold calling experience in 3 to 5 sentences: what you called for, how many calls a day, and your best result.

2. Send a voice recording (under 1 minute) reading this out loud as if you were on a real call:

"Hey, is this Mike? Hey Mike, it's [your name] calling for Corey at Jobsite Web Co. Honestly, this is a cold call. Can I tell you why I picked you, and you can hang up if it's not a fit? Congrats on your new contractor license. Right now when someone Googles Ace Plumbing, nothing comes up, so those calls go to whoever does show up."

3. Tell us which 4-hour block, in US Pacific time, you can work every weekday.

4. Put the word "TOOLBELT" at the top of your application so we know you read this far.



Applications without the voice recording won't be reviewed.

title: Insurance Claims Specialist/ Xactimate Estimator
description:
Job Overview



Roofing Knights is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and experienced **Insurance Claims Specialist & Xactimate Estimator** to support our residential roofing insurance claims operations.



The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Xactimate estimating, insurance claim documentation, supplement preparation, and communication with insurance adjusters.



This position focuses primarily on **claims administration, estimating, supplement preparation, and insurance carrier coordination**. Direct homeowner communication is not a regular responsibility and will only be required when specifically authorized by management.



The candidate must also be proficient in 
 CRM, Google Workspace, and digital roofing measurement and documentation tools.



## Key Responsibilities



**1. Insurance Claims Management**

- Manage and monitor roofing insurance claims from initial filing through final settlement and payment.

- Review insurance estimates, claim documents, scopes of loss, depreciation, deductibles, and payment summaries.

- Identify missing items, underpaid line items, and discrepancies between insurance estimates and documented roof damage.

- Track claim progress, pending supplements, approvals, and outstanding insurance payments.

- Coordinate internally with project managers, field inspectors, and management regarding claim requirements.



**2. Xactimate Estimating & Supplements**

- Prepare accurate, detailed Xactimate estimates using current local pricing, roofing materials, labor, and applicable waste factors.

- Review and compare insurance carrier estimates against contractor estimates and documented field conditions.

- Prepare and submit supplements supported by roof measurements, photographs, building codes, and material specifications.

- Identify missing roofing components, including underlayment, flashing, ventilation, decking, and other applicable items.

- Review aerial roof measurement reports from EagleView, Roofr, and similar platforms.



**3. Insurance Adjuster Coordination**

- Communicate professionally with insurance adjusters and claim representatives regarding estimates, supplements, documentation, and claim status.

- Follow up on pending supplement approvals, revised estimates, and insurance payment releases.

- Address scope discrepancies and provide supporting documentation to justify requested adjustments.

- Escalate disputed or unresolved claim matters to management when necessary.

- Maintain complete records of insurance communications and claim-related correspondence.



**4. 
 CRM Management**

- Proficiently navigate and utilize 
 CRM for daily claims management.

- Update claim statuses, assigned tasks, follow-up schedules, and project progress.

- Upload and organize insurance estimates, supplement documents, photographs, and related claim files.

- Monitor deadlines, pending approvals, and outstanding insurance payments.

- Maintain accurate, organized, and up-to-date project records for management review.



**5. Google Workspace & Administrative Coordination**

- Proficient in Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs, and Google Sheets.

- Prepare, send, and respond to professional
s using company Google Workspace accounts.

- Organize and manage electronic claim documents, estimates, and supporting files.

- Maintain clear written communication with insurance companies, adjusters, and internal team members.

- Prepare claim summaries, progress updates, and reports as requested by management.



**6. Roofing Documentation & Code Research**

- Review roof inspection reports, damage assessments, and photographic documentation.

- Understand California roofing installation standards, applicable building codes, and manufacturer requirements.

- Identify documentation needed to support roofing insurance supplements.

- Coordinate with field personnel to obtain missing photographs, measurements, and other supporting evidence.



## Required Qualifications



- **Experience:** Minimum 2 years of professional experience in US property insurance claims estimating, preferably residential roofing.

- **Xactimate:** Advanced proficiency in preparing, reviewing, and revising estimates and supplements.

- **Insurance Knowledge:** Strong understanding of US insurance claim procedures, RCV, ACV, recoverable depreciation, deductibles, and supplement processing.

- **CRM Experience:** Practical experience using 
 CRM, including navigation, status updates, task management, file organization, and reporting.

- **Google Workspace:** Proficiency in Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs, and Google Sheets.

- **Roof Measurements:** Familiarity with EagleView, Roofr, or similar aerial roof measurement platforms.

- **Communication:** Strong written and verbal English skills, particularly for professional correspondence with insurance adjusters.

- **Organization:** Ability to manage multiple active insurance claims, meet deadlines, and maintain accurate records with minimal supervision.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Xactimate Level 2 or Level 3 certification.

- Previous experience working with US roofing contractors or insurance restoration companies.

- Strong knowledge of California residential roofing construction codes and industry terminology.

- Experience preparing insurance supplements involving roof decking, underlayment, flashing, ventilation, and code-required items.

- Familiarity with CompanyCam or similar field documentation platforms.



## Important Role Expectations



- This is primarily an **insurance estimating and claims coordination position**, not a homeowner-facing customer service role.

- Homeowner communication regarding insurance coverage, policy benefits, or claim settlement matters must be authorized by management.

- All estimates, supplements, and claim-related documentation must be accurate, properly supported, and submitted through approved company procedures.

- Claim negotiations and settlement-related matters must remain within the employee's authorized responsibilities and applicable laws and regulations.

- Consistent CRM updates, professional
 communication, and timely follow-ups are essential.



## Why Join Roofing Knights?



- **Career Growth:** Opportunities for advancement into Senior Estimator, Claims Operations Lead, or management positions.

- **Professional Development:** Gain experience managing complex California residential roofing insurance claims.

- **Technology-Driven Workflow:** Work with Xactimate, 
 CRM, Google Workspace, CompanyCam, and aerial roof measurement platforms.

- **Collaborative Environment:** Work directly with an experienced roofing operations and project management team.



## How to Apply



Interested candidates should submit their **updated resume and a brief cover letter** highlighting their Xactimate experience, insurance supplement preparation, 
 CRM proficiency, and experience working with US insurance carriers.



*
:** 



*
 Subject:** Application – Insurance Claims Specialist & Xactimate Estimator

title: Customer Follow-Up & Scheduling Specialist (Fluent English Required)
description:
Hiring: Experienced Customer Service & Appointment Setting Specialist (Remote)



Company: Chuck’s Flooring

Location: Remote – Philippines

Industry: Home Improvement / Flooring

Position: Customer Service Representative (CSR) & Appointment Setter



About Chuck’s Flooring



Chuck’s Flooring is a growing, family-owned flooring company serving homeowners in South Carolina and North Carolina.



We’re looking for a skilled, confident, and results-driven Customer Service Representative who knows how to turn incoming inquiries into qualified appointments.



This is not a basic customer support position. We’re looking for someone who understands sales psychology, communicates naturally with American customers, and knows how to guide conversations toward booking without being pushy.



Your Responsibilities



* Contact new leads promptly after they submit an inquiry.

* Follow up with existing leads in our CRM pipeline.

* Handle inbound and outbound calls, text messages, and customer communication.

* Build rapport with homeowners and confidently guide them toward scheduling an estimate.

* Schedule appointments at our designated time slots:

    * 9:00 AM

    * 12:00 PM

    * 3:00 PM

    * 6:00 PM (Monday–Friday)

* Maintain consistent follow-up with unresponsive leads:

    * Up to 3 attempts daily during the first 30 days.

    * 1 attempt daily during the second month.

* Keep accurate customer notes, follow-up records, and appointment statuses.

* Qualify projects before scheduling to ensure our sales representatives are meeting with the right homeowners.



What Makes an Appointment Qualified?



We value quality over quantity.



A qualified appointment means:



* The homeowner is genuinely interested in flooring installation or replacement.

* The project matches the services Chuck’s Flooring offers.

* The customer is seeking an actual flooring project, not small handyman repairs.

* The homeowner understands the purpose of the in-home estimate and agrees to the appointment.

* The customer is available and prepared to discuss their flooring needs.



Who We’re Looking For



Required Qualifications:



* Excellent spoken and written English, with clear, natural communication.

* Strong phone confidence and professional customer service skills.

* Experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, or sales.

* Ability to handle objections and hesitant customers professionally.

* A proactive, persuasive, and customer-focused communication style.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently and maintain consistent follow-ups.

* Reliable internet connection, a quiet workspace, and dependable availability.



Preferred Qualifications:



* Experience working with US-based businesses or American customers.

* Background in home improvement, home services, or related industries.

* Experience using CRM software such as GoHighLevel.

* Proven success booking appointments or converting inbound leads.

* Familiarity with consultative selling and relationship-based sales techniques.



Compensation & Opportunities



* Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.

* Performance-based booking bonuses for qualified appointments scheduled.

* Opportunities for growth as our company continues expanding.

* Established systems, organized lead pipelines, and ongoing support.



Systems & Training Provided



You’ll have access to our customer management and communication systems, allowing you to call, text, track leads, and manage follow-ups efficiently.



We provide structured training on our services, qualification standards, appointment process, and customer communication expectations.



We’re looking for someone who already has strong communication and sales fundamentals and can quickly learn our processes.



What Makes Someone Successful Here?



The best candidate doesn’t simply read a script or make calls to hit a number.



They know how to listen, ask thoughtful questions, understand customer needs, handle hesitation, and make homeowners feel comfortable taking the next step.



We want someone who takes ownership of their results and understands that consistent, professional follow-up drives appointments.



How to Apply



To demonstrate attention to detail, please begin your application with the word “Flooring”.



1. Tell us about your phone-based experience.



Have you handled inbound calls, outbound calls, appointment setting, or sales? What types of customers or industries have you worked with?



2. How would you handle this objection?



A homeowner says:



“I’m just looking right now. I’m not ready to schedule anything yet.”



Explain how you would respond naturally and professionally to move the conversation forward.



3. What makes an appointment qualified?



Explain how you determine whether a homeowner is genuinely interested and ready for an in-home flooring estimate.



4. Share your previous results.



If you have appointment-setting experience, tell us approximately how many calls you handled daily, how many appointments you scheduled, and how you measured success.



5. Submit a 2–3 minute voice recording.



Pretend you’re calling an American homeowner who just submitted an online flooring inquiry.



Introduce yourself, explain the reason for your call, ask relevant questions, and naturally guide the homeowner toward scheduling an estimate.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



⸻



We’re looking for experienced professionals who want to grow with a company, deliver excellent customer experiences, and take pride in their results.

NOW HIRING: Social Media Manager & Strategist (AI-Savvy)



Remote | Part-Time | Flexible Hours



ABOUT US



Queen Clean is a growing commercial and residential cleaning company based in Bozeman, Montana, USA.



We're looking for a creative, proactive, and results-driven Social Media Manager & Strategist to help strengthen our online presence, grow our audience, and improve our overall social media footprint.



We're not just looking for someone who can create pretty graphics or schedule posts. We want someone who understands social media strategy, account management, analytics, a local audience, and how to turn creative ideas into measurable results.



We're especially interested in someone who has experience working with U.S.-based businesses and knows how to leverage AI tools to improve marketing, content creation, and overall social media marketing impact.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Social Media Management & Strategy



• Develop and implement social media strategies aligned with our business goals.

• Manage social media accounts, including content planning, scheduling, publishing, and performance monitoring.

• Identify opportunities to improve brand awareness, audience engagement, and growth.

• Research trends, competitors, and creative marketing opportunities.



Content Creation & AI Integration



• Create engaging graphics, captions, reels, and short-form video content.

• Maintain a consistent brand identity and voice across platforms.

• Use AI tools to improve creativity, productivity, and marketing workflows.

• Explore new content ideas and creative approaches relevant to our local market.



Analytics & Performance



• Monitor social media analytics and track relevant performance metrics.

• Identify what works, what needs improvement, and why.

• Provide clear performance updates and actionable recommendations.

• Continuously refine strategies based on actual data and results.



Team Collaboration



• Collaborate with Queen Clean's owner and management team.

• Participate in scheduled Google Meet co-working and strategy sessions.

• Communicate progress, share ideas, and provide recommendations proactively.

• Manage deadlines and follow through on agreed priorities.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



• Minimum of 2 years of professional social media management and marketing experience with U.S.-based businesses or clients, either within a company or as an independent contractor.

• Demonstrated ownership of social media strategy, execution, performance, and measurable results.

• Platform Expertise: Demonstrated experience managing business accounts across major platforms, including
, Instagram, LinkedIn, and TikTok, as applicable.

• Content Planning and Execution: Experience developing and managing content calendars, writing engaging copy, coordinating creative assets, scheduling posts, and maintaining consistent brand messaging.

• Performance Optimization: Ability to interpret analytics, identify opportunities, and proactively adjust strategies to improve reach, engagement, traffic, and conversions.

• Community Management: Experience monitoring comments, messages, and audience engagement while maintaining a professional brand voice.

• Marketing Tools: Proficiency with social media scheduling, publishing, reporting, and content creation tools.

• Portfolio: Strong portfolio showing previous work, managed accounts, and actual analytics or performance results.

• Social Media Strategy: Experience developing social media strategies, not just creating content.

• Analytics and Reporting: Familiarity with social media analytics and performance reporting.

• AI Proficiency: Knowledge of AI tools and their practical applications in marketing.

• Communication Skills: Excellent written English and understanding of U.S. audiences.

• Professional Attributes: Creative, detail-oriented, organized, and reliable.

• Independence and Initiative: Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable working independently.

• Collaboration: Comfortable collaborating in real time through Google Meet.



Nice to Have:



• Experience creating AI avatars or AI-generated videos.

• Experience marketing local service-based businesses.

• Experience with AI-assisted video editing and content creation.



WORK SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY



This is a remote, part-time position with flexible hours.



Much of the work can be completed independently. However, we're looking for someone who can provide some consistent availability during our Montana business hours:



9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time (Montana, USA)



You do not need to work the entire 9–5 schedule.



However, you must be comfortable joining scheduled Google Meet co-working sessions to collaborate, discuss strategies, review performance, and work together on marketing initiatives.



Clear communication, reliability, and the ability to work collaboratively are important to us.



OPPORTUNITY FOR GROWTH



We're looking for someone who wants more than just another short-term project.



This position will begin as part-time, with the possibility of expanding as Queen Clean continues to grow.



We value creativity, initiative, accountability, and someone who genuinely enjoys helping a small business succeed.



HOW TO APPLY



If you're interested in joining our team, please complete our application form:







In your OnlineJobs.ph application message, please briefly answer the following questions:



1. Why are you interested in this role, and what makes you a strong fit?

2. Which social media management, design, scheduling, and analytics tools have you used?

WHAT TO EXPECT DURING OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS



As part of our interview process, candidates should be prepared to share and discuss:



• Portfolio and Work Examples: Social media accounts you've managed, content you've created, and strategies you've developed.

• Organic Performance: Actual metrics demonstrating results, such as reach, engagement, audience growth, website traffic, and conversions.

• Campaign Performance: Examples of campaigns you've managed, including objectives, execution, performance metrics, and outcomes.

• Strategy and Decision Making: Your role in developing strategies, evaluating performance, and making adjustments to improve results.

• Professional References: Please be prepared to provide 2–3 professional references from previous clients or employers if you advance to the next stages of our hiring process.



We're interested in understanding not just the work you've produced, but the results you've achieved and your direct contribution to those outcomes.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Please include the keyword QUEEN somewhere in your OnlineJobs.ph application message.



APPLICATIONS WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY DISQUALIFIED IF:



• The required Google Form has not been completed and submitted.

• The keyword QUEEN cannot be found in your OnlineJobs.ph application message.



Both requirements must be met for your application to be considered.



We value attention to detail, initiative, and candidates who carefully follow instructions.



We look forward to learning more about you! 💜



Queen Clean | Bozeman, Montana, USA

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter, Neutral Accent (Full-Time, Soft Sales, US Hours)
description:
Hi there!



We're a US sales agency hiring a full-time remote phone caller with a clear, neutral English accent.



The Job

You call independent natural food stores in the US and offer the buyer a free product placement. It is a relaxed, soft-sell role, not hard sales. Most calls take 3 to 4 minutes. On a calling day, our callers typically get 3 to 10 stores to say yes.



Who We're Looking For

Neutral-accent spoken English that US store buyers understand easily. We check this with your voice sample.

Phone experience with US customers is preferred, not required. If you are talented and new to this, apply.

A headset and a quiet room, so your voice comes through clearly. Wired internet and a USB headset are preferred.

Someone who wants a steady, long-term role and will be excited to do it well.



Schedule (Required)

Full time, Monday to Friday, 10:00 pm to 6:00 am Philippine time (9:00 pm to 5:00 am from mid-March to early November). That is 9:00 am to 5:00 pm US Eastern time. Full time is preferred. If you are a strong caller who can only work 20 to 30 hours a week inside those hours, apply and tell us your availability.



Pay

$5 per hour plus $3 for each store that says yes. Our part-time callers have earned about $25 to $120 in bonuses per two-week pay period when calling consistently. The rate rises to $6 per hour once you have shown strong performance and stayed with us, typically 3 to 6 months. Paid every two weeks. Independent contractor.



Timeline and Paid Trial

Interviews start right away. Training starts in early December, with three 3-hour paid trial shifts at $5 per hour. Calling starts in early 2027.



How to Apply

Send a short voice sample in English with your application. One you already have is fine. A Vocaroo link is best (free, no sign-up). A Google Drive link or an audio file works too. A Loom video works too. Please turn on downloading, because we download it to review it. Applications without a voice sample will not be reviewed.

title: Personal Assistant
description:
I’m looking for a sweet, bubbly, and sassy high-level Personal Assistant to work directly with me as my right hand. Most of this role is executive assistant work: running my calendar, priorities, making phone calls, communication, and projects. The rest is personal logistics, keeping my life outside of work organized so I can stay focused.



I’ll be upfront. This is a demanding role, not a basic admin job. You will be in the middle of everything I’m doing, day to day, as our company scales fast.



*You must speak English with little to no accent.*



About me and the company



I’m the co-founder and COO of BookDrop, a fast-growing bulk book logistics and resale company. We’ve more than doubled headcount in the last year and we’re not slowing down. I need someone who is organized, proactive, warm, and hungry to be the best assistant they can possibly be. Not someone looking for a comfortable job. Someone who wants to be trusted with real responsibility and become indispensable to an executive long-term.



The details



Full-time remote, based in the Philippines, working Arizona hours (starting 6:00 AM AZ time flexible).



What you’ll do



Act as my right-hand partner in daily execution and organization

Manage my calendar, scheduling, reminders, and priorities

Organize communication, follow-ups, and task tracking

Support operations, growth projects, and leadership workflows

Handle personal logistics: travel, appointments, purchases, family scheduling, and the small things that pile up

Build clean systems in Google Sheets and other tools

Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) every day to draft, research, organize, and move faster



This role requires serious initiative. You don’t wait to be told every step. You think ahead, bring solutions, and stay steady when things move fast.



Required skills



Advanced Google Sheets skills

Real, hands-on experience using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT. Non-negotiable. You should be using AI daily, not something you tried once.

*Strong English communication, written and spoken*

Highly organized and comfortable juggling many priorities at once

Tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools

Reliable internet and the ability to work US hours





Who thrives here



Wants to be THE best assistant



If you read the expectations above and felt excited instead of nervous, you’re probably who I’m looking for.





How to apply



Send your resume to 
 with “More Books!” in the subject line and include a roughly 2-minute video covering:



What is your favorite non-fiction book and why?

Why you’d be a good fit for this role



The video is how I judge your English and vibe. TIP - Be camera ready, dont be too formal (relax and have fun), and dont choose atomic habits as your favorite book.



Also feel free to send any attachments that show your Google Sheets and AI skills.



Applications without both a resume and a video will not be reviewed.

title: Experienced Outbound Sales Closer / Appointment Setter (3+ Years Exp)
description:
About us

Bee Man Dan LLC is a Houston, Texas bee removal and hive relocation company. We find hives with thermal imaging, have served Houston families since 2015, and are 5-star Google-rated. Our operations team works remotely from the Philippines.



What you will do

You are our closer. Your job is to turn warm leads into booked jobs and sales.



- Close hive removal customers: call back hive removal quote requests and warm leads, confirm the address and ZIP code, explain the value of safe, professional removal and relocation, handle price objections, and book the job using our script and talking points.

- Buzz for Gold: call people who signed up for our collectible silver coin promotion and have not purchased yet. Answer questions clearly and honestly, and guide them to complete the purchase. No false claims and no promises about results. (about 2 to 3 hours a day)

- Research referral partners (pest control companies, property managers, real estate agents, roofers) and record them in a tracker. B2B calling starts in spring.

- Log every call and outcome in our call tracker and ClickUp, and hand off bookings to the right teammate.

- Build fresh leads through circle prospecting when call volume is low.



Incentives (on top of base pay)



- You earn a per-coin incentive for every Buzz for Gold coin you close, and the rate goes up as volume goes up.

- You earn a per-booking incentive for every hive removal you book that is completed.

- Retention bonuses at 30 and 60 days.

- Incentives are paid at your biweekly payday, and the full structure is shared with the selected candidate at hiring.

- Because you are calling warm leads, strong callers can earn well above the base rate. Results depend on lead volume and your calls, and we do not guarantee earnings.



What we are looking for

This is NOT an entry-level role. We need a proven outbound closer who can show results. Please apply only if you meet the requirements below.



Required:



- At least 3 years of OUTBOUND phone sales experience (cold calling, lead follow-up, or appointment setting). 

- A track record of closing sales and booking appointments in real estate cold calling (expired, FSBO, absentee owners), B2B appointment setting, pest control, or home services.

- You can tell us your numbers: calls per day, appointments booked or sales closed per week or month, and one result you are proud of.

- Comfortable handling objections and asking for the sale or the appointment without pressure tactics.

- Clear, natural spoken English with US callers.

- Honest, coachable, and able to follow a script.

- Quiet workspace, headset, stable internet, and a backup connection or power.



Applications that do not state years of outbound experience and the industry will not be reviewed.



Nice to have (we will train you):



- US pest control, home services, or lead callback experience

- Comfortable researching online and keeping a clean Google Sheet



Schedule

Monday to Friday, 3 to 5 hours a day during Central Time (Houston) daytime hours, which is evening or overnight in the Philippines. Exact shift hours are confirmed at hiring and kept consistent.



Terms

1. Independent contractor, paid biweekly via Wise or direct to bank. 

2. Check-in at the end of week 1; decision at the end of the week.

3. Strong performers can move to more hours.



How to apply



1. Start your message with the word BEE.

2. Attach your resume.

3. Send a 2 to 3 minute VIDEO (strongly preferred). Use a Loom, Google Drive or unlisted YouTube link and make sure we can open it. Audio-only is accepted, but video applications are reviewed first. Show your face, sit in a quiet room, and use your headset. Say your name and the word BEE, then answer:

a) Tell us about your calling experience: the industry, how many years, calls per day, your close or booking rate, and one result you are proud of.

b) A homeowner says "That's too expensive" or "I'll think about it" after hearing the price. What do you say next, honestly and without pressure?

c) You are calling someone who signed up for our silver coin promotion but has not bought yet. Give us your opening 20 seconds.

d) Write your available hours in Central Time and your earliest start date.

title: Carrier Onboarding Representative
description:
GH Logistics is a growing freight brokerage and asset-based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. Our strength comes from reliable carrier partnerships, disciplined execution, clean communication, and scalable capacity across the U.S. As our network continues to expand, we are looking for a Carrier Onboarding Representative to help identify, verify, onboard, and develop relationships with reliable trucking carriers across our priority markets.



This role is not just about adding carriers to our network. It is about building a dependable carrier base, maintaining strong relationships, and ensuring our operations teams have access to qualified carriers when capacity is needed.



Role Overview

You are responsible for sourcing, vetting, onboarding, and maintaining relationships with qualified carriers while supporting the growth and reliability of GH Logistics' carrier network. You will work directly with U.S.-based trucking companies to identify carriers operating in our priority markets, verify their qualifications, complete onboarding requirements, and maintain accurate carrier records.



This is a high volume and phone-based role that requires persistence, organization, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced freight environment. This role does not involve booking loads or negotiating freight rates. Your primary responsibility is to ensure qualified, verified carriers are properly onboarded, documented, and connected with the appropriate internal teams. This role is strictly for fluent English speakers, as the position requires constant communication with U.S.-based carriers and internal team members throughout the shift.



What You'll Be Doing



Carrier Sourcing and Network Development

• Make at least 30 outbound calls daily to identify and connect with potential carriers.

• Handle approximately 20 inbound calls daily related to carrier inquiries, onboarding, and follow-ups.

• Identify reliable carriers actively operating in GH Logistics' priority markets.

• Build professional relationships with carrier owners, dispatchers, and fleet representatives.

• Introduce GH Logistics and explain our carrier onboarding process, freight network, and communication expectations.

• Identify carrier operating areas, preferred lanes, equipment types, and availability.

• Follow up with existing carriers to maintain engagement and updated information.

• Focus on developing long-term carrier relationships rather than simply increasing onboarding numbers.



Carrier Verification and Fraud Prevention

• Verify carriers using approved tools

• Review carrier operating authority, insurance coverage, safety records, and compliance information.

• Check the company's Do Not Use (DNU) list before proceeding with onboarding.

• Identify potential red flags involving fraud, double brokering, or suspicious carrier information.

• Ensure all verification requirements are completed before onboarding a carrier.

• Escalate questionable carriers or compliance concerns to management.

• Follow company-approved verification procedures without skipping required steps.



Carrier Onboarding and Documentation

• Successfully onboard at least 3 qualified carriers daily.

• Complete all required carrier onboarding documentation accurately and efficiently.

• Ensure carrier information and compliance records are complete and up to date.

• Create at least 1 group chat daily with a newly onboarded carrier to establish direct communication.

• Immediately post every newly onboarded carrier in the designated channel.

• Ensure every onboarded carrier is properly recorded and accessible to the appropriate internal teams.

• Coordinate with internal teams to ensure newly onboarded carriers are ready for potential freight opportunities.



Carrier Relationship Management and Tracking

• Update and maintain spreadsheet daily.

• Track carrier onboarding activity, call volume, follow-ups, and carrier information.

• Maintain accurate carrier contact information, operating preferences, and relevant details.

• Monitor existing carrier records and update information as needed.

• Ensure all onboarded carriers are properly documented and included in the appropriate tracking systems.

• Maintain organized daily activity logs and communication records.

• Coordinate with internal teams to address carrier-related inquiries or concerns.



Directory and Communication Management

• Maintain the GH Logistics carrier directory and designated group chats.

• Add new contacts and remove outdated or inactive members as needed.

• Ensure appropriate team members are included in required communication groups.

• Maintain accurate group membership and required administrative access.

• Escalate missing information, access restrictions, or communication issues to management.

• Keep carrier communication organized, professional, and accessible to internal teams.



What Success Looks Like

• Consistently completes 30 outbound calls daily.

• Handles approximately 20 inbound calls daily.

• Successfully onboards at least 3 qualified carriers daily.

• Creates at least 1 group chat daily with a newly onboarded carrier.

• Every onboarded carrier is properly verified through approved tools.

• No carriers on the DNU list are onboarded.

• All newly onboarded carriers are immediately posted in the communication channel.

• Carrier records, tracking spreadsheets, and directories remain accurate and updated.

• Builds and maintains reliable carrier relationships that support long-term network growth.

• Consistently meets daily activity and onboarding targets without sacrificing quality.

• Demonstrates urgency, accountability, and strong communication in a fast-paced freight environment.



Who We're Looking For

• Experience in Carrier Onboarding, Carrier Sales, Freight Brokerage, Dispatch, or U.S. Trucking Operations is preferred.

• Fluent English communication skills, both verbal and written.

• Comfortable making high volume outbound calls and handling inbound carrier inquiries.

• Familiarity with U.S. carrier verification, insurance, operating authority, and safety compliance.

• Experience with logistiics platforms is a strong advantage.

• Highly organized, tech-savvy, and comfortable managing multiple spreadsheets and communication channels.

• Strong attention to detail when reviewing carrier documentation and maintaining records.

• Proactive, persistent, and confident when communicating with trucking companies.

• Capable of building professional relationships and maintaining consistent carrier follow-ups.

• Thrives in a fast-paced, high-urgency freight environment.

• Performance-driven, KPI-oriented, and comfortable working with measurable daily targets.

• Follows instructions consistently and executes tasks with precision.

• Able to work independently while coordinating effectively with internal teams.

• Team-oriented, coachable, and open to feedback without ego.



Schedule and Work Setup

• Work Arrangement: Full-Time Remote | Direct Engagement with a US Company

• Available shift: Monday -  Friday 7 AM - 5 PM Central Time

• Active, attentive, and proactive Zoom participation with camera on is required throughout scheduled shifts.

• Time tracking software is used for accountability and performance monitoring.

• Reliable internet connection, backup internet and power supply, and a suitable remote workspace are required.



What You'll Get

• Long-Term Opportunity: An ongoing leadership role within a growing US logistics company.

• Monthly Stipend: $75 monthly insurance stipend, with eligibility beginning after 30 days of engagement.

• Regular Payment Schedule: Payments processed twice monthly according to established payroll schedules.

• Direct US Operations Exposure: Work closely with US-based logistics teams and operational leadership.

• Meaningful Operational Impact: Help build a reliable carrier network, prevent freight fraud through proper verification, and strengthen GH Logistics' capacity to support consistent freight coverage.

• Structured Workflows: Established carrier onboarding procedures, clear daily KPIs, organized tracking systems, and opportunities to improve carrier relationships and network efficiency.



If you're someone who enjoys connecting with people, thrives in a high-volume calling environment, and takes pride in building reliable business relationships, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply Here: 



Note: After submission, our team will review your information and contact you if you meet the qualifications for the role. Candidates with direct experience in U.S. freight brokerage, carrier onboarding, or trucking operations will be prioritized.

DVE Business Solutions is seeking an experienced and proactive Developer to support the growth and ongoing development of our web-based placements management system, which helps education providers coordinate student placements and manage related workflows. This is a casual role to start, with the intention to evolve into a full-time position for the right person.

We’re looking for someone who is technically capable, communicates clearly and enjoys solving problems in a collaborative, evolving environment.



The role will also contribute to AI-enabled features and automation, as well as using AI-assisted development tools to support coding, testing and documentation. You will help turn agreed requirements into practical solutions under our Senior Developer’s guidance.

• Working closely with our Senior Developer to understand the platform’s architecture, functionality and integrations.

• Collaborating with internal stakeholders to translate business and user requirements into maintainable technical solutions.

• Working with our Technical Project Manager to plan assigned tasks, communicate progress and raise blockers early.

• Applying secure development practices and protecting source code, credentials and sensitive information.

• Sharing knowledge and contributing to continuous improvement within our international team.



Technical Environment: 



You will work within our internal development team, following the technical direction of our Senior Developer and collaborating with our Technical Project Manager on priorities and delivery. 

Our technical environment includes:

• Frontend: Vue.js - Single Page Application framework.

• Backend: Laravel and PHP.

• Cloud Infrastructure: AWS, including ECS and containerisation.

• Integrations: RESTful APIs and third-party services.

• Development and Deployment: Git, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.

• AI Development: AI-assisted coding tools and AI service or large language model API integrations, according to product requirements.

  

You have (selection criteria):

• Solid hands-on experience with Vue.js and Laravel, including developing and maintaining existing applications.

• Experience working with RESTful APIs, relational databases, Git and collaborative development workflows.

• Practical experience using AI tools in software development, with the ability to review, test and explain the code you deliver.

• An understanding of how AI services can be integrated into web applications. Experience building AI-enabled features or workflow automation would be an advantage.

• Experience with automated testing and an understanding of secure coding practices.

• Familiarity with AWS, containerisation and CI/CD pipelines.

• Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working in a remote team.

• A proactive, solution-focused mindset and confidence asking questions or raising concerns.

• The ability to manage multiple priorities, meet agreed commitments and adapt as requirements evolve.

 

About DVE  

  

• We know Education! We specialise and care about making a difference in this sector.   

• We work on a wide range of interesting projects and provide outcomes that make a difference.  

• We enjoy flexible work practices with our clients and team around Australia and internationally.  

• We offer the ability to develop your own role and career path as we embark on our next stage of growth together.   

• We have a friendly, collaborative and flexible work environment.  

• Our Values are: We practice what we preach | We maintain client focus | We work as one team | We enjoy what we do!  

• We are recognised in our sector and community with awards such as Telstra Business Awards, Cool Company and more  

• Salary package including base salary and bonus structure commensurate with experience and mutual expectations in the role.    

  

Our projects across the sector cover three business lines:

• Student Success & Operational Excellence - helping institutions improve student journeys, strengthen administration and deliver more effective services and processes.

• Governance, Compliance & Risk - supporting institutions with regulatory requirements, governance, quality assurance and risk management.

• Digital & AI Transformation - helping institutions improve how they work through digital solutions, AI and automation, including our own placements management system.

 

NEXT STEP
